samples.source: With streaming synthesis enabled, the time to first playable audio drops below 800 milliseconds.
samples.reference: 启用流式合成之后，首段可播延迟降到 800 毫秒以内。
samples.hypothesis: 随着流体合成的启用,第一次可播放音频的时间下降到800毫秒以下.

samples.source: The VAD model split this recording into three speech segments and dropped the silent parts.
samples.reference: VAD 模型把这段录音切成了三个语音段，静音部分被丢弃。
samples.hypothesis: VAD模式将这段录音分为三个语音部分,并放下了静音部分.

samples.source: After int8 quantization, Kokoro v1.1 ships at roughly 320 MB and Mandarin naturalness is close to usable.
samples.reference: Kokoro v1.1 用 int8 量化后模型体积约 320 MB，中文自然度接近可用。
samples.hypothesis: 在Int8量产后,Kokoro v1.1号舰船在大约320MB和普通话自然状态下接近可用.

samples.source: SenseVoice's automatic language detection is not very stable on Cantonese-Mandarin code-switched speech.
samples.reference: SenseVoice 的自动语言检测在粤夹普的语料上表现不太稳定。
samples.hypothesis: SenseVoice的自动语言检测在广东话-曼达林密码切换语中不甚稳定.

samples.source: The realtime mode runs through argos with end-to-end latency around 200 ms, fast enough for face-to-face scenarios.
samples.reference: 实时档走 argos，端到端延迟约 200 毫秒，够做面对面场景。
samples.hypothesis: 实时模式通过algos运行,端到端间距在200ms左右,速度足够用于面对面的场景.

samples.source: The quality mode chains madlad and ollama and prioritizes accuracy over a latency budget.
samples.reference: 精译档走 madlad 加 ollama，质量优先，不承诺延迟预算。
samples.hypothesis: 质量模式将疯人院和奥拉马院锁在一起,并将准确性置于长期预算之上。

samples.source: Privacy mode is a hard invariant: no configuration can route cloud engines into the pipeline.
samples.reference: 隐私模式是硬不变量，任何配置都无法把云端引擎纳入路由。
samples.hypothesis: 隐私模式是难以变体:任何配置都无法将云引擎送入管道.

samples.source: Once the translation memory hit rate passes thirty percent, cost is essentially a one-time model expense.
samples.reference: 翻译记忆命中率超过三成时，成本几乎只剩模型侧的一次性开销。
samples.hypothesis: 一旦翻译记忆冲击率超过30%,费用基本上是一次性模型费用。

samples.source: A buffer that is too small causes stuttering; one that is too large inflates end-to-end latency.
samples.reference: 缓冲区太小会造成卡顿；太大会推高端到端延迟。
samples.hypothesis: 一个太小的缓冲会导致扭动;一个太大膨胀的端到端间悬浮.

samples.source: The sample rate and bit depth of audio determine the volume of raw waveform data.
samples.reference: 音频的采样率与位深决定了原始波形的数据量。
samples.hypothesis: 音频的样本率和比特深度决定了原始波形数据的体积.

samples.source: Mono 16 kHz 16-bit is the most common input format for automatic speech recognition.
samples.reference: 单声道 16 千赫兹 16 位是语音识别最常见的输入格式。
samples.hypothesis: Mono 16 kHz 16-bit是自动语音识别最常用的输入格式.

samples.source: Stereo dual-channel audio is usually down-mixed to mono before being fed to the ASR model in a dubbing workflow.
samples.reference: 双声道立体声在配音场景里通常会被下混回单声道再送入 ASR。
samples.hypothesis: 立体声双声道音频通常在被调制工作流程中输入ASR模式之前,会向下混合为单声道.

samples.source: A frame size of 25 ms and a frame shift of 10 ms is the standard setup for acoustic feature extraction.
samples.reference: 帧长 25 毫秒、帧移 10 毫秒是声学特征提取的常规配置。
samples.hypothesis: 帧大小为25ms,帧移为10ms,是声学特征提取的标准设置.

samples.source: The mel spectrogram is the key intermediate representation that turns a waveform into something the model can read.
samples.reference: 梅尔频谱图是把波形转换成模型可读输入的关键中间表示。
samples.hypothesis: mel谱系是将波形转化为模型能读到的东西的关键中间代表.

samples.source: Forced alignment lines up the reference text and the recognition output word by word, used to generate timestamps.
samples.reference: 强制对齐可以把参考文本与识别输出逐字对齐，用于时间戳生成。
samples.hypothesis: 强制对齐将参考文本和识别输出单词逐字排列,用于生成时间戳.

samples.source: Inverse text normalization converts "two thousand twenty-six" into "2026" so downstream parsing is simpler.
samples.reference: 逆文本规整把 "二零二六年" 转成 "2026 年"，让下游解析更简单。
samples.hypothesis: 反文本正常化将"2千26"转换为"2026",因此下游剖析更为简单.

samples.source: In code-switched sentences, domain terminology should be pulled from the glossary rather than left to the model's imagination.
samples.reference: 中英混排句子里，专用术语最好走术语表而不是让模型自由发挥。
samples.hypothesis: 在代码切换句子中,域名术语应从词汇中抽出,而不是留待模型的想象.

samples.source: Prompt injection into Ollama must explicitly disable thinking mode, otherwise the time to first token doubles.
samples.reference: Ollama 的提示注入要显式禁用思考模式，不然首字延迟会翻倍。
samples.hypothesis: 迅速注射到奥拉马必须明确禁用思维模式,否则第一令牌双胞胎的时间.

samples.source: The CUDA provider gives TTS roughly a three-times speedup on this RTX 4050.
samples.reference: CUDA 提供程序在这块 RTX 4050 上给 TTS 带来的加速约 3 倍。
samples.hypothesis: CUDA提供商给予TTS大约3次在这种RTX 4050上的速度.

samples.source: Running a 3B int8 model on CPU is realistically 2 to 4 seconds per sentence, not fit for realtime scenarios.
samples.reference: CPU 上跑 3B int8 模型的现实是每句 2 到 4 秒，不适合实时场景。
samples.hypothesis: 在CPU上运行一个3B int8模型,实际上每句2-4秒,不适合实时情景.

samples.source: The subtitle track exported as SRT can be read directly by players without re-encoding the video.
samples.reference: 字幕轨导出成 SRT 之后可以直接被播放器读取，不需要重新编码视频。
samples.hypothesis: 作为 SRT 输出的字幕音轨可以由玩家直接读取,而无需重新编码视频.

samples.source: Bilingual subtitles require timing alignment: the Chinese and English lines must share the same time window.
samples.reference: 双语字幕要求时序对齐：中文行与英文行必须落在同一时间窗口内。
samples.hypothesis: 双语字幕需要时间对齐:中英文线必须共享同一时间窗口.

samples.source: Burned-in subtitles are part of the picture, so editing them later requires re-encoding; soft subtitles can be swapped at any time.
samples.reference: 硬字幕是烧进画面的，之后想改只能重编码；软字幕可以随时替换。
samples.hypothesis: 烧制的字幕是画面的一部分,所以编辑后需要重新编码;软字幕可以随时互换.

samples.source: Dubbing and lip sync are separate concerns: the first replaces the audio, the second keeps the picture in sync.
samples.reference: 配音与对口型是两回事：前者关注语音替换，后者关注画面同步。
samples.hypothesis: 杜宾语和唇语同步是独立的关注:第一种是替换音频,第二种是保持图片同步.

samples.source: Audio-video sync error within 40 milliseconds is imperceptible to human viewers.
samples.reference: 声画同步误差控制在 40 毫秒以内，人眼才不会觉得违和。
samples.hypothesis: 40毫秒内的音频视频同步错误对人类观众来说是无法察觉的.

samples.source: A higher quantization parameter means a smaller bitrate but worse quality; the trade-off has to be tuned.
samples.reference: 量化参数越高压缩率越高但画质损失越明显，需要在两者之间取舍。
samples.hypothesis: 更高的量化参数表示比特率较小但质量更差;权衡必须调和.

samples.source: A longer GOP lowers bitrate but makes seek response sluggish; live streaming usually caps it at two seconds.
samples.reference: GOP 越长比特率越低但快进快退越迟钝，直播场景一般不超过 2 秒。
samples.hypothesis: 较长的GOP会降低比特率,但会使求应迟缓;活流通常会在2秒内封顶.

samples.source: Word error rate and character error rate are not interchangeable; Chinese benchmarks typically report character error rate.
samples.reference: 词错误率与字符错误率不能相互替代，中文更常用字符错误率。
samples.hypothesis: 单词错误率和字符错误率不能互换;汉语基准一般报告字符错误率.

samples.source: FLORES-101 is general domain, still a distributional mismatch with the confidential-document and batch-localization scenarios this product targets.
samples.reference: FLORES-101 是通用域，与产品主打的涉密文档与批量本地化场景仍有分布差。
samples.hypothesis: FLORES-101是一般域,仍然与本产品目标的机密文件和批量本地化设想的分布不匹配.

samples.source: The glossary is looked up by language pair; entries with the same source term collide between generic and domain rows, so the primary key needs a domain segment.
samples.reference: 术语表按语言对检索，同名条目在通用与领域之间会冲突，需要 domain 段来分组。
samples.hypothesis: 术语表按语言对齐来查看;条目的源词相同,在通用行和域行之间碰撞,所以主键需要域段.

samples.source: Lowering the voice activity detection threshold cuts breathing into speech segments as well; raising it swallows weak syllables at sentence ends.
samples.reference: 语音活动检测的阈值调低会把呼吸声也切成语音段，调高则会吞掉句末弱读。
samples.hypothesis: 降低语音活动探测阈值也会将呼吸阻断为语音部分;在句尾将其提高后吞下弱音节.

samples.source: Post-processing for automatic speech recognition usually involves two independent steps: punctuation restoration and number normalization.
samples.reference: 自动语音识别的后处理通常包含标点恢复与数字规整两个独立步骤。
samples.hypothesis: 自动语音识别的处理后通常涉及两个独立的步骤:点解恢复和数字正常化.

samples.source: In neural machine translation the encoder squeezes the source sentence into a context vector and the decoder autoregressively generates the target sentence.
samples.reference: 神经机器翻译的编码器把源句压成上下文向量，解码器再自回归生成目标句。
samples.hypothesis: 在神经机翻译中,编码器将源句挤压成上下文向量,解码器自动生成目标句.

samples.source: The text-to-speech frontend runs three stages -- tokenization, grapheme-to-phoneme conversion and prosody prediction -- and a failure in any of them hurts naturalness.
samples.reference: 文本转语音的前端要做分词、字音转换和韵律预测三级流水，任一级掉链子都会破坏自然度。
samples.hypothesis: 文本对语音前端贯穿三个阶段——标致化,石墨对手机转换和prosody预测——其中任何一个的失败都会伤害自然.

samples.source: Streaming recognition differs from offline recognition not only in latency but also in the consistency between prefix hypotheses and the final result.
samples.reference: 流式识别与离线识别的差别不只是延迟，还包括前缀假设与最终结果的一致性。
samples.hypothesis: 流化识别不仅与离线识别不同,不仅在耐久性,而且在前缀假设与最终结果的一致性方面也不同.

samples.source: The most common trade-off when productizing real-time interpretation is "buying accuracy with latency", and the sliding-window size directly determines both.
samples.reference: 同声传译产品化时最常见的取舍是 "延迟换准确率"，滑窗大小直接决定这两者。
samples.hypothesis: 生产实时解释时最常见的权衡是"用耐久性购买精度",滑窗大小直接决定了两者.

samples.source: A batch localization pipeline must survive a thousand-sentence run for hours without crashing, which makes checkpoint-resume and idempotent retries hard requirements.
samples.reference: 批量本地化管线要能在 1000 句的规模下保持每小时不崩，因此断点续传与幂等重跑是硬要求。
samples.hypothesis: 成批的本地化管道必须经过千人行刑数小时而不坠毁,这就使得检查站的恢复和一流的重复要求变得很困难。

samples.source: Speech translation and text translation share the same routing: TM hit, privacy clamp, per-language-pair tiering, confidence gating and AI upgrade.
samples.reference: 语音翻译与文本翻译共用同一套路由：TM 命中、隐私钳制、语言对分档、置信度门控、AI 升级。
samples.hypothesis: 语音翻译和文本翻译共用相同的路由:TM命中,隐私夹,每语言-pair分级,置信gating和AI升级.

samples.source: Endpoint detection is stricter than VAD -- it has to distinguish "sentence finished" from "pause inside a sentence".
samples.reference: 端点检测比 VAD 更严格，它需要区分 "句子说完" 与 "句中停顿"。
samples.hypothesis: 端点检测比VAD更严格——它必须区分"判决完成"和"在句子内暂停".

samples.source: Speaker diarization works well on meeting recordings but degrades visibly on podcasts with overlapping speech.
samples.reference: 说话人分离在会议录音上表现好，在重叠说话的播客里就明显退化。
samples.hypothesis: 发言者的对称化在会议录音方面效果很好,但在播客上却明显退化,发言相互重叠。

samples.source: Expressive speech synthesis needs an extra prosody conditioning channel and cannot rely on the text frontend alone.
samples.reference: 情感语音合成需要额外一路韵律条件，不能只靠文本前端。
samples.hypothesis: 表达式语音合成需要额外的音素调节通道,不能单靠文本前端.

samples.source: Zero-shot speaker cloning can start from just five seconds of reference audio but is sensitive to sample rate and signal-to-noise ratio.
samples.reference: 零样本音色克隆只要 5 秒参考音频就能起步，但对采样率与信噪比敏感。
samples.hypothesis: 零镜头扬声器克隆可以从仅5秒的参考音频开始,但对样本率和信号对噪比敏感.

samples.source: A speech recognition confidence score cannot be lifted directly into a translation confidence score; their calibration curves are entirely different.
samples.reference: 语音识别的置信度分数不能直接搬到翻译置信度上，两者校准曲线完全不同。
samples.hypothesis: 语音识别信心分数不能直接提升为翻译自信分数;其校准曲线完全不同.

samples.source: Among Kokoro's Mandarin voices at sid 45-52, 52 handles CJK/Latin code-switching best while 48 sits closer to a broadcast tone.
samples.reference: Kokoro 的中文男声 sid 45-52 中，52 混排表现最好，48 更贴近播音腔。
samples.hypothesis: 在第45-52号的科科罗的普通话语音中,有52个处理CJK/拉丁语代码切换最佳,48个则坐得更接近广播音调.

samples.source: Whisper-style models drift on long audio, so the standard slicing policy follows VAD boundaries rather than a fixed 30 seconds.
samples.reference: Whisper 类模型在长语音上会漂移，切片策略一般按 VAD 边界而不是固定 30 秒。
samples.hypothesis: 低声模式在长音上漂移,因此标准切片政策遵循VAD边界,而不是固定的30秒.

samples.source: The causality constraint in streaming ASR means the current hypothesis cannot look ahead to future frames -- a fundamental difference from offline models.
samples.reference: 流式 ASR 的因果性约束意味着当前的识别不能引用未来帧，与离线模型有本质差别。
samples.hypothesis: 串流ASR的因果关系制约意味着目前的假设无法展望未来的帧——这是与离线模型的根本区别.

samples.source: Real-time subtitles usually stabilize the prefix and let the suffix float, so a single sentence is not rewritten three times for the reader.
samples.reference: 实时字幕的常见做法是稳定前缀 + 浮动后缀，让阅读体验不至于一句话改三遍。
samples.hypothesis: 实时字幕通常稳定前缀,让后缀浮出水面,因此单句不为读者重写3次.

samples.source: Batch localization jobs often run overnight, so log aggregation and assertion-style failures must be replayable after the fact.
samples.reference: 批量本地化任务往往跨夜跑，日志聚合与断言式失败必须能事后重放。
samples.hypothesis: 批量本地化工作往往在一夜之间运行,因此日志汇总和断言式的失败必须在事后重新播放.

samples.source: End-to-end speech translation collapses ASR, MT and TTS into a single model, trading interpretability for lower latency.
samples.reference: 端到端语音翻译把 ASR、MT、TTS 融成一个模型，牺牲可解释性换更低延迟。
samples.hypothesis: 端到端的语音翻译崩溃了ASR,MT和TTS成为单一的模型,交易可解释性以降低延迟.

samples.source: The audio sample rate and bit depth set the Nyquist ceiling; 16 kHz speech can only carry content below 8 kHz.
samples.reference: 语音采样率与位深决定了奈奎斯特频率上限，16 千赫兹的语音只能表达 8 千赫兹以下的成分。
samples.hypothesis: 音频样本率和比特深度设置了Nyquist天花板;16 kHz语音只能携带低于8 kHz的内容.

samples.source: A vocoder inverts the spectrum back into a waveform -- Griffin-Lim is slow and muddy, while neural vocoders are fast and clean.
samples.reference: 声码器负责把频谱反演回波形，Griffin-Lim 慢而糊，神经网络声码器快且清晰。
samples.hypothesis: 一个vocoder将光谱反转回波形——Griffin-Lim是缓慢和泥巴化的,而神经vocoders是快速和干净的.

samples.source: Fundamental-frequency estimation usually uses autocorrelation or YIN; both are accurate on voiced segments, but unvoiced segments are noise by definition.
samples.reference: 基频 F0 的估计常用自相关或 YIN 算法，浊音段准，清音段本身就是噪声。
samples.hypothesis: 基础频率估计通常使用自动脉动或YIN;在表达的片段上两者都准确,但非语音片段顾名思义是噪声.

samples.source: The first 40 cepstral coefficients already cover most of the spectral detail the human ear can distinguish.
samples.reference: 倒谱系数取前 40 维已经足够覆盖大部分人耳可辨的频谱特征。
samples.hypothesis: 最初的40个cepstral系数已经覆盖了人类耳朵能够辨别的大部分光谱细节.

samples.source: Down-mixing stereo to mono should normalize by energy rather than average samples, otherwise the phase difference between channels colors the output.
samples.reference: 立体声到单声道 down-mix 需要按能量归一而不是简单平均，不然左右声道的相位差会引入染色。
samples.hypothesis: 向下混合的立体到单体应该通过能量而不是平均样品实现常态化,否则通道之间的相位差异会给输出配色.

samples.source: Silence compression keeps only the segments VAD flags as speech, saving 30 to 50 percent of the length on typical meeting recordings.
samples.reference: 静音压缩通过保留 VAD 判定的语音段来实现，会议录音可以省下 30% 到 50% 时长。
samples.hypothesis: 静音压缩只保留部分VAD旗作为语音,在典型的会议录音上节省了30%至50%的长度.

samples.source: Resampling from 48 kHz to 16 kHz must apply an anti-aliasing low-pass filter first, otherwise high frequencies fold into the speech band.
samples.reference: 重采样从 48 千赫兹降到 16 千赫兹要先做抗混叠低通滤波，不然高频会折叠进语音带。
samples.hypothesis: 从48kHz恢复到16kHz必须先应用反异名低通滤波器,否则高频折叠到语音波段.

samples.source: Field recordings with a signal-to-noise ratio below 10 dB usually need denoising before being sent to ASR.
samples.reference: 信噪比低于 10 分贝的现场录音通常要先做降噪再送 ASR。
samples.hypothesis: 信号对噪比低于10 dB的场录音通常在发送到ASR前需要去诺.

samples.source: Pre-emphasis filtering lifts high frequencies so that later feature extraction is more sensitive to weak fricatives.
samples.reference: 预加重滤波把高频抬起来，能让后续特征提取对小擦音更敏感。
samples.hypothesis: 前强调式滤波可以提升高频,这样后期特征提取对弱的风化剂更为敏感.

samples.source: A Hamming window is standard during framing and noticeably reduces the Gibbs ringing a rectangular window would introduce.
samples.reference: 分帧时常用的汉明窗能显著削弱矩形窗带来的吉布斯振铃。
samples.hypothesis: 汉明窗在设定过程中是标准,明显减少Gibbs响起的长方形窗会引入.

samples.source: A 25 fps frame rate is normal for film; 50 fps makes viewers feel it "looks too much like news footage".
samples.reference: 帧率 25 fps 是影视的常规，50 fps 会让观众觉得 "太像新闻"。
samples.hypothesis: 25fps帧率对电影来说是正常的;50fps让观众觉得它"看起来太像新闻片段".

samples.source: Raising bit depth from 16 to 24 does not increase loudness but improves dynamic range and quantization noise noticeably.
samples.reference: 位深度从 16 升到 24 位不会让响度更大，但动态范围与量化噪声显著改善。
samples.hypothesis: 将比特深度从16提高到24并不增加音响,而是显著地改进了动态范围,并量化了噪音。

samples.source: Audio-video sync has to leave a small buffer skew in the encoding chain -- video is typically about 20 ms behind audio.
samples.reference: 音画同步在编码链路上要留一个音视频缓冲差，视频通常比音频晚 20 毫秒。
samples.hypothesis: 音频-视频同步必须在编码链中留下一个小缓冲skew——视频一般在音频后面约20ms.

samples.source: Down-mixing from 5.1 to stereo should use Dolby Pro Logic rather than a straight sum.
samples.reference: 声道布局从 5.1 下混到立体声要用 Dolby Pro Logic 而不是简单相加。
samples.hypothesis: 从5.1到立体音的下调混合应该使用Dolby Pro Logic,而不是直接的总和.

samples.source: Spectral centroid, zero-crossing rate and energy are enough to separate music from speech.
samples.reference: 频谱质心、零过率、能量这三个特征就能把音乐与语音分开。
samples.hypothesis: 光谱的心律,零交叉率和能量足以将音乐和语音区分开来.

samples.source: The mel scale mirrors the non-linear frequency perception of human hearing; a linear FFT binning does not match psychoacoustics.
samples.reference: 梅尔刻度是仿人耳感知非线性；线性刻度做 FFT 直接分箱不符合听觉心理。
samples.hypothesis: mel比例镜反映了人类听觉的非线性频率感知;线性FFFT binning不匹配心理声学.

samples.source: Pitch period and formants are the two most basic concepts in the physical model of speech production.
samples.reference: 基音周期与共振峰是语音产生物理模型里最基础的两个概念。
samples.hypothesis: 皮奇期和造型剂是语音制作物理模型中两个最基本的概念.

samples.source: Voiceprint recognition and speaker diarization are not the same: the first identifies a fixed set of speakers, the second only clusters without identities.
samples.reference: 声纹识别与说话人分离是两回事：前者固定身份集合做识别，后者只做聚类不分身份。
samples.hypothesis: 语音印识别和扬声器的比化并不相同:第一种是识别一组固定的扬声器,第二种是没有身份的唯一集群.

samples.source: Insufficient audio buffering causes dropouts, insufficient video buffering causes frame skips -- different symptoms but the same root cause is backpressure.
samples.reference: 音频缓冲不足会引发 dropout，视频缓冲不足会引发跳帧，两者表现不同但根因都是背压。
samples.hypothesis: 音频缓冲不足导致辍学,视频缓冲不足导致帧跳过-不同症状,但同一根源是后压.

samples.source: In streaming protocols chunk and packet are often used interchangeably, but for latency accounting they are two different concepts.
samples.reference: 流式协议里 chunk 与 packet 常被混用，但对时延统计而言是两个概念。
samples.hypothesis: 在串流协议中,块和包常常互换使用,但对于长期性核算来说,它们是两个不同的概念。

samples.source: A jitter buffer dynamically retargets delay -- pushing it down to 20 ms when the network is good and stretching it to 200 ms when the network is bad.
samples.reference: 抖动缓冲动态调整目标延迟，网络好时压到 20 毫秒，网络差时拉到 200 毫秒。
samples.hypothesis: 一个焦急的缓冲动态重定向延迟——当网络好时将其推低至20ms,当网络坏时将其拉长至200ms.

samples.source: Any throughput bottleneck in a pipeline will back up everything upstream, so the backpressure signal has to propagate all the way to the input.
samples.reference: 流水线里任何一级的吞吐瓶颈都会把上游顶爆，反压信号必须能一路传回输入端。
samples.hypothesis: 管道中的任何吞吐瓶颈都会支撑上游的一切,因此后压信号必须一直向输入传播.

samples.source: TCP retransmission ruins real-time behaviour; low-latency audio and video usually ride on UDP with forward error correction.
samples.reference: TCP 的重传会破坏实时性，音视频低延迟场景普遍走 UDP 加前向纠错。
samples.hypothesis: TCP重传破坏实时行为;低频音频和视频通常在UDP上搭载前方错误校正.

samples.source: Keyframes spaced too far apart make seeking stutter; too close and the bitrate doubles for the same quality.
samples.reference: 关键帧间隔太长会让 seek 卡顿，太短会让相同画质下比特率翻倍。
samples.hypothesis: 键框间距太远,使得寻求结巴;太近,比特率双倍达到同样的质量.

samples.source: Chunked processing needs 50 percent overlap between adjacent chunks, otherwise the energy estimate jumps at the boundaries.
samples.reference: 分块处理时相邻块要有 50% 重叠，不然边界处的能量估计会跳变。
samples.hypothesis: 断层处理需要相邻块之间 50%的重叠, 否则能量估计会跳跃到边界。

samples.source: Flush means "emit everything currently in the buffer and terminate this segment".
samples.reference: 冲刷操作的语义是 "把当前缓冲里的内容全部吐出去并结束本段"。
samples.hypothesis: Flush意为"清除目前缓冲中的一切并终止此段".

samples.source: If backpressure is not designed in an end-to-end pipeline, a slow consumer at the tail stalls the entire chain.
samples.reference: 端到端流水线里背压没设计好时，最下游的消费者慢就整条链堵死。
samples.hypothesis: 如果背压不是在端对端管道中设计的,尾端的慢消费者会拖住整个链条.

samples.source: Buffer prefetch usually counts in frames, not in seconds, because a frame is the atomic unit of the model.
samples.reference: 缓冲预取一般按帧数而不是按时长，因为帧才是模型的原子单位。
samples.hypothesis: 缓冲前置通常以帧计数,而非秒计数,因为一个帧是模型的原子单位.

samples.source: Streaming synthesis boundaries should land after a word or phrase; cutting at a particle or conjunction is audibly jarring.
samples.reference: 流式合成的边界要落在词或短语之后，切在助词或连词中间会明显刺耳。
samples.hypothesis: 流化合成边界应在一个词或短语之后着陆;切到颗粒或结合处会发出声响。

samples.source: When the datagram transport protocol drops one or two packets, the decoder should gracefully conceal rather than crash.
samples.reference: 数据报传输协议丢一两个包时解码器要能优雅丢帧而不是崩。
samples.hypothesis: 当数据gram传输协议掉下一两个包时,解码器应该优雅地隐藏而不是崩溃.

samples.source: Constant bitrate suits broadcast, variable bitrate suits storage -- their buffering models are completely different.
samples.reference: 恒定比特率适合广播，可变比特率适合存储；两者的缓冲模型完全不同。
samples.hypothesis: 恒定比特率套装广播,可变比特率套装存储——它们的缓冲模型完全不同.

samples.source: The container only handles packaging and synchronisation; the codec handles compression. Turning an mkv into an mp4 needs no re-encoding.
samples.reference: 容器只负责封装与同步，编解码器负责压缩；把 mkv 转成 mp4 不需要重编码。
samples.hypothesis: 容器只处理包装和同步; 解码器处理压缩。 将 mkv 转换为 mp4 不需要重新编码 。

samples.source: The network abstraction layer of the bitstream carries timing and composition information; missing it leaves the decoder unable to render correctly.
samples.reference: 比特流的网络抽象层携带时序与合成信息，缺失会让解码器无法正确解码。
samples.hypothesis: 比特流的网络抽象层带有时间和组成信息;缺失后,解码器无法正确渲染.

samples.source: The encoder must declare its profile and level explicitly so the player can decide whether it can accept this stream.
samples.reference: 编码器要显式声明 profile 与 level，播放器据此判断能不能吃下这条流。
samples.hypothesis: 编码器必须明确声明其配置和关卡,以便玩家可以决定是否可以接受这个流.

samples.source: Demultiplexing means splitting a container into its video, audio and subtitle tracks without decoding anything.
samples.reference: 解复用就是把一个容器拆开成若干条音视频字幕轨，不做任何解码。
samples.hypothesis: 分解是指将一个容器分解到它的视频,音频和字幕音轨中,而无需对任何东西进行解码.

samples.source: Lossless compression entropy-codes the waveform and can restore it bit-for-bit; lossy compression introduces quantization error.
samples.reference: 无损压缩对波形做熵编码，可以逐比特还原；有损压缩引入量化误差。
samples.hypothesis: 无损失压缩式 ⁇ -编码波形并可以恢复其位元;无损失压缩引入定量错误.

samples.source: Transcoding between different source and target codecs must go through a frame buffer for reorder.
samples.reference: 转码时如果源和目标编解码器不同，一定要经过帧缓冲重排。
samples.hypothesis: 不同源与目标编码器之间的转码必须通过帧缓冲器进行重排.

samples.source: Intra-frame prediction depends only on the current frame; inter-frame prediction references other frames, and the two propagate errors differently.
samples.reference: 帧内预测只依赖当前帧，帧间预测要引用参考帧，二者的错误传播特性不同。
samples.hypothesis: 帧内预测只取决于当前帧;帧间预测参考了其他帧,两个误差传播方式不同.

samples.source: A larger motion-estimation search radius is more accurate but slower; 16 pixels is the common default.
samples.reference: 运动估计的搜索半径越大越精确但也越慢，默认 16 像素是常见折中。
samples.hypothesis: 一个更大的运动估计搜索半径更准确但更慢;16像素是常见的默认.

samples.source: Entropy coding uses Huffman or arithmetic coding -- the latter is slightly more efficient but carries patent and complexity overhead.
samples.reference: 熵编码用霍夫曼或算术编码；算术编码效率略高但专利与复杂度都是负担。
samples.hypothesis: Entropy编码使用Huffman或算术编码——后者效率略高,但带有专利和复杂性的间接费用.

samples.source: Rate control should be content-aware: lower bitrate for static scenes, higher bitrate for motion-heavy scenes.
samples.reference: 码率控制要感知内容，静态场景压低码率，运动场景放开码率。
samples.hypothesis: 速率控制应该是意识到内容的:静态场景的比特率较低,运动重度场景的比特率较高.

samples.source: Each generation from AVC to HEVC to VVC roughly halves the bitrate for the same quality but doubles the complexity.
samples.reference: AVC、HEVC、VVC 每一代同画质下比特率大致降一半，复杂度大约翻倍。
samples.hypothesis: 从AVC到HEVC到VVC的每代都大致将同样质量的比特率减半,但复杂度却翻了一番.

samples.source: Opus adapts between 6 and 512 kbps and is the default choice for voice on the internet.
samples.reference: Opus 在 6 到 512 千比特率之间自适应，是互联网语音的默认选择。
samples.hypothesis: Opus在6至512 kbps之间适应,是互联网上语音的默认选择.

samples.source: FLAC compresses losslessly around 5:1 and is suited to archiving masters; MP3 is lossy and should never be secondarily compressed.
samples.reference: FLAC 无损压缩率大约 5:1，适合母带归档；MP3 是有损，别用来做二压。
samples.hypothesis: FLAC在5:1左右进行无损失的压缩,并适合归档主机;MP3是亏损的,不应该被第二压缩.

samples.source: Video subtitles have to handle three independent problems: line-width wrapping, character encoding and missing glyphs.
samples.reference: 视频字幕要处理换行宽度、字符编码与字体缺字三个独立问题。
samples.hypothesis: 视频字幕必须处理三个独立的问题:线宽包装,字符编码和缺失的glyph.

samples.source: SubRip only has timing and text fields, weak styling; ASS adds event and style sections and can express karaoke effects.
samples.reference: SubRip 只有时间轴与文本两栏，样式能力弱；ASS 有事件与样式两栏，能表达卡拉OK。
samples.hypothesis: SubRip只有时间和文本字段,风格薄弱;ASS增加了事件和风格部分,可以表达卡拉OK效果.

samples.source: WebVTT is the W3C-defined subtitle format for the web and slots straight into HTML5 players.
samples.reference: WebVTT 是 W3C 定义的网页字幕格式，天然与 HTML5 播放器对接。
samples.hypothesis: WebVTT是W3C定义的网络字幕格式,槽直接进入HTML5播放器.

samples.source: Word-level timestamps require forced-alignment output; ASR alone only provides segment-level timing.
samples.reference: 逐字时间戳需要强制对齐输出，纯 ASR 只有段级时间戳。
samples.hypothesis: Word-level timetamps需要强制对齐输出;单是ASR只提供段级计时.

samples.source: Subtitle line breaks should follow meaning rather than character count; splitting "audio-video sync" across two lines wrecks readability.
samples.reference: 字幕断行要按语义而不是按字符数：把 "声画同步" 拆到两行会破坏阅读。
samples.hypothesis: 字幕的换行符应该遵循意义而不是字符计数;将"Audio-video同步"划分为两行残骸的可读性.

samples.source: Burning in subtitles means extracting frames, drawing captions and re-encoding -- each step can add a generation of loss.
samples.reference: 硬字幕化流程 = 抽帧、烧字、重编码；每一步都可能引入代际损失。
samples.hypothesis: 在字幕中燃烧意味着提取帧,绘制字幕和重新编码——每一步可以增加一代损失.

samples.source: Lip-sync algorithms track mouth keypoints on real people and match frame-by-frame energy envelopes on animation.
samples.reference: 对口型算法在真人上主要看嘴部关键点，在动画上要看帧与语音能量包络。
samples.hypothesis: Lip-sync算法追踪真实人物的口键点,并在动画上匹配逐帧能量信封.

samples.source: When dubbing, duck the original audio by 12 dB or viewers will miss the new voice.
samples.reference: 配音时原声要压低 12 分贝做 ducking，不然观众听不清配音。
samples.hypothesis: 配音时,由12 dB或观众遮掩原声会错过新声.

samples.source: Voiceover scenes usually keep a little background ambience; pure silence makes the viewer drop out of the scene.
samples.reference: 解说场景往往需要保留少量背景音，纯静音配音会让人出戏。
samples.hypothesis: Voiceover的场景通常保持一点背景氛围;纯粹的沉默使得观众退出场景.

samples.source: Multi-role dubbing must synthesise each speaker separately by diarization result, then remux by timestamp.
samples.reference: 多角色配音要按说话人分离结果分别合成，再按时间戳混流。
samples.hypothesis: 多作用的配音必须用配音结果将每个扬声器分别合成,然后用时间戳进行remux.

samples.source: When bilingual subtitles have mismatched segment counts, split segments rather than let them drift out of phase.
samples.reference: 双语字幕对齐时如果两边段落数不同，宁可拆段也不要错开。
samples.hypothesis: 当双语字幕不匹配的片段计数时,会分拆片段,而不是让片段漂移出阶段.

samples.source: Timeline drift accumulates on long videos; check the anchors by hand every ten minutes.
samples.reference: 时间轴漂移在长视频里会累积，每 10 分钟要人工核对一次锚点。
samples.hypothesis: 时间线漂流在长视频上累积;每10分钟用手检查一次主播.

samples.source: Extracting an audio track usually uses ffmpeg's -vn flag; the cost is remuxing, not re-encoding.
samples.reference: 音轨抽取常用 ffmpeg 的 -vn 参数，代价是重封装而不是重编码。
samples.hypothesis: 提取音频音轨通常使用ffmpeg的 -vn 旗;成本是重置,而不是重置编码.

samples.source: Embedding subtitles into the video stream lets even non-subtitle players display them, at the cost of losing the on/off toggle.
samples.reference: 字幕嵌入视频流会让不支持字幕的播放器也能显示，代价是不可关闭。
samples.hypothesis: 在视频流中嵌入字幕,甚至让非字幕角色展示,代价是失去上下切换.

samples.source: Remuxing a video where the codec has not changed can copy packet-by-packet and finish in seconds.
samples.reference: 视频重封装时如果编码格式没变，可以逐包拷贝，秒级完成。
samples.hypothesis: 复制一个代码没有更改的视频可以逐个复制包,并在数秒后完成 。

samples.source: Frame-accurate subtitle alignment requires millisecond timestamps; segment-level accuracy is not enough for fast speech.
samples.reference: 帧精确的字幕对齐要求毫秒级时间戳，段级精度在快语速时不够用。
samples.hypothesis: 帧精确的字幕校正需要毫秒的倍调图;段级的准确性不足以进行快速的语音.

samples.source: SMPTE 12-hour timecode has drop-frame and non-drop-frame variants at 30 fps; state which one when synchronising across systems.
samples.reference: 时间码 SMPTE 12 小时制在 30 帧率下有掉帧与非掉帧两种，跨系统同步时要显式声明。
samples.hypothesis: SMPTE 12小时时段代码在30 fps时有空投帧和非空投帧变体;在跨系统同步时说明哪一个.

samples.source: Dubbing scripts must match the duration of the original video; when writing translations, estimate the syllable budget from visible mouth openness.
samples.reference: 配音脚本的时长要与原视频对齐，写译文时要按 "口型开放度" 估算音节上限。
samples.hypothesis: Dubbing脚本必须符合原视频的长度;在撰写翻译时,从可见的口腔开口估计音节预算.

samples.source: A model checkpoint should store weights, optimiser state and the tokenizer together, so resuming training and inference are both easy.
samples.reference: 模型检查点最好同时保存权重、优化器状态与 tokenizer，方便续训与推理。
samples.hypothesis: 一个示范检查站应该将重量、选择状态和标注器放在一起,因此恢复培训和推论都很容易。

samples.source: Subword tokenization breaks unknown words into combinable pieces; vocabulary size and merge granularity are directly related.
samples.reference: 子词切分把未登录词拆成可组合的部件，词表大小与切分粒度直接相关。
samples.hypothesis: 子词符号化将未知的单词断成可调解的片段;词汇大小和合并颗粒性是直接相关的.

samples.source: Byte-pair encoding starts from characters and repeatedly merges the most frequent pairs, producing a vocabulary optimised for that corpus.
samples.reference: 字节对编码从字符级开始反复合并高频对，构造出面向该语料的最优词表。
samples.hypothesis: 字节-pair编码从字符开始,并反复合并最频繁的对子,产生一个对该元件最优化的词汇.

samples.source: Word embeddings map symbols into continuous space so that semantically similar words lie close together in the vector space.
samples.reference: 词嵌入把符号映射到连续空间，语义相近的词在向量空间里距离更近。
samples.hypothesis: 单词将映射符号嵌入到连续空间中,这样在矢量空间中就能够形成像样的单词相近.

samples.source: Attention allows the decoder at every step to softly inspect every position in the source sentence.
samples.reference: 注意力机制允许解码器在每一步软选择性地查看源句的所有位置。
samples.hypothesis: 注意可以让每个步骤的解码器软化地检查源句中的每一个位置.

samples.source: The Transformer replaces recurrence with self-attention -- high parallelism during training, but KV-cache cost at inference time.
samples.reference: Transformer 用自注意力替代循环结构，训练时并行度高但推理时 KV 缓存吃内存。
samples.hypothesis: "变形器"以自觉取代重现——在训练中高度平行,但KV-cache在推论时间成本.

samples.source: Quantising to int8 shrinks the model to about a third of its size; the speed gain depends on hardware and operators.
samples.reference: 量化到 int8 后模型体积大约压到三分之一，速度提升视硬件与算子而定。
samples.hypothesis: 量到Int8使模型缩小到约三分之一的大小;速度增益取决于硬件和运算符.

samples.source: Half-precision fp16 keeps the dynamic range of floats and is used heavily in training; int8 is used heavily in inference.
samples.reference: 半精度 fp16 保留浮点动态范围，训练时用得多；int8 推理时用得多。
samples.hypothesis: 半精度fp16保持了浮标的动态范围,在训练中被大量使用;int8被大量使用推论.

samples.source: Knowledge distillation feeds the soft labels of a large model into a small model so the latter approaches the former's accuracy.
samples.reference: 知识蒸馏把大模型的软标签灌给小模型，让后者逼近前者的准确率。
samples.hypothesis: 知识蒸馏将一个大模型的软标签输入一个小模型,所以后者接近前者的精度.

samples.source: The teacher might have 30B parameters and the student only 1B; a distilled student loses surprisingly little on a narrow task.
samples.reference: 教师模型可以是 30B 参数，学生模型压到 1B，蒸馏后小模型在窄任务上不掉太多。
samples.hypothesis: 老师可能有30B参数,学生只有1B;一个被蒸馏的学生在狭义的任务上损失惊人的少.

samples.source: Fine-tuning continues training on a domain-specific corpus at a much lower learning rate than pretraining.
samples.reference: 微调在特定领域语料上继续训练，学习率要显著低于预训练阶段。
samples.hypothesis: 精细调整继续以比预培训低得多的学习率对特定领域进行训练。

samples.source: LoRA only trains two low-rank matrices, less than one percent of the base model's parameter count.
samples.reference: LoRA 只训练两个低秩矩阵，参数量与原模型相比不到百分之一。
samples.hypothesis: 洛拉只训练两个低级矩阵,不到基模型参数数的1%.

samples.source: At inference time, larger batch size raises throughput but also latency; realtime pipelines usually lock batch=1.
samples.reference: 推理时 batch size 越大吞吐越高但延迟也越长，实时场景往往锁死 batch=1。
samples.hypothesis: 推算时,较大的批量尺寸会提高吞吐量,但也会产生耐久性;实时管道通常会锁定批量=1.

samples.source: More threads are not always better; ONNX's inter-op and intra-op thread counts have to be tuned separately.
samples.reference: 线程数不是越多越好；ONNX 的 inter-op 与 intra-op 要分开调。
samples.hypothesis: 更多的线程并不总是更好的;ONNX的跨线程和内线程计数必须分别调制.

samples.source: Operator fusion collapses several small operators into one, reducing memory round-trips and scheduling overhead.
samples.reference: 算子融合把多个小算子合并成一个大算子，减少内存往返与调度开销。
samples.hypothesis: 操作员聚变使几个小操作员崩溃成一个操作员,减少了内存的回转和排程管理费.

samples.source: Computation-graph optimisation is the core work of an inference framework; graph partitioning decides which operators stay on CPU and which move to GPU.
samples.reference: 计算图优化是推理框架的核心工作，图切分决定哪些算子留在 CPU 哪些上 GPU。
samples.hypothesis: 计算-图优化是推论框架的核心工作;图分区决定哪些操作员停留在CPU上,哪些操作员移动到GPU.

samples.source: Choosing the runtime provider matters a lot -- the same model can be 5 to 10 times faster on CUDA than on CPU.
samples.reference: 运行时提供程序的选择影响极大，同一模型在 CUDA 与 CPU 上可能差 5 到 10 倍。
samples.hypothesis: 选择运行时间提供者很重要——在CUDA上同一型号可以比CPU快5到10倍.

samples.source: When VRAM is insufficient Ollama offloads some layers to main memory; throughput collapses but the process survives.
samples.reference: 显存不足时 Ollama 会自动把部分层卸载到内存，速度骤降但不会崩。
samples.hypothesis: 当 VRAM 不足 Ollama 卸下一些层到主内存时;吞吐量崩溃但过程存活下来.

samples.source: The product of batch size and sequence length determines the VRAM cost of the KV cache.
samples.reference: 批大小与序列长度的乘积决定 KV 缓存的显存开销。
samples.hypothesis: 批量大小和序列长度的产品决定了KV缓存的VRAM成本.

samples.source: A multilingual model covers more than a hundred languages with one set of weights, and quality on cold pairs is usually much lower than on hot pairs.
samples.reference: 多语言模型用一份参数覆盖 100 多种语言，冷门语向的质量通常明显低于热门语向。
samples.hypothesis: 一个多语种模型覆盖了100多种语言,有一套重量,冷配对的质量通常比热配对要低得多.

samples.source: The tokenizer and the model's vocabulary must match exactly; a mismatch produces garbled output without raising an error.
samples.reference: 分词器与模型的词表必须严格匹配，错配会导致输出乱码但不报错。
samples.hypothesis: 标致器和模型的词汇必须精确匹配;不匹配产生加带的输出而不会引起错误.

samples.source: Temperature sampling flattens the probability distribution and yields more varied output, but translation typically wants lower temperature.
samples.reference: 温度采样把概率分布拉平，让模型输出更多样，但翻译场景通常希望更低温度。
samples.hypothesis: 温度采样使概率分布趋于平坦,产出更加多样,但翻译通常需要更低的温度。

samples.source: The context window is a hard constraint on the LLM; long documents must be truncated or fed one sentence at a time.
samples.reference: 上下文窗口是 LLM 的硬约束，长文档翻译要么截断要么分段喂。
samples.hypothesis: 上下文窗口是 LLM 的硬约束;长的文档必须一次切换或输入一句话.

samples.source: Listing the glossary explicitly inside the system prompt significantly reduces terminology errors but consumes input tokens.
samples.reference: 系统提示里显式列出术语表可以显著降低专业词错译，但会占用输入 token。
samples.hypothesis: 在系统内明确列出术语表会显著减少术语错误,但会消耗输入符号。

samples.source: Few-shot examples put the user's preferred rendering directly in front of the model, which beats any abstract instruction.
samples.reference: 少样本示例把 "用户希望的译法" 直接摆到模型眼前，比抽象指令更有效。
samples.hypothesis: 少有镜头的例子将用户的首选渲染直接放在模型前,这比任何抽象指示都好.

samples.source: Glossaries must be filtered by the current request's language pair and domain; feeding irrelevant rows only dilutes attention.
samples.reference: 术语表要按当前请求的语言对与领域过滤，把不相关条目喂给模型只会稀释注意力。
samples.hypothesis: Glossaries必须被当前请求的语言对称和域过滤;喂食不相关的行只会稀释注意力.

samples.source: Translation memory matches exactly -- a hit is zero-cost; fuzzy matching is a different problem and brings ranking noise.
samples.reference: 翻译记忆是精确匹配，命中即零成本；模糊匹配是另一码事，会引入排序噪声。
samples.hypothesis: 翻译内存完全匹配——一个命中是零成本;模糊匹配是一个不同的问题,并带来排名噪声.

samples.source: Confidence gating is the switch between local output and AI upgrade; too permissive a threshold wastes API calls.
samples.reference: 置信度门控是本地结果与 AI 升级之间的开关，阈值定太松会白白多花一次 API。
samples.hypothesis: 信心标注是本地输出和AI升级之间的切换;太允许阈值废物 API 调用.

samples.source: The quality score records each TM entry's historical reliability -- AI writes at 0.95, local estimates its own, manual writes 1.0.
samples.reference: 质量分记录每条 TM 的历史可信度，AI 写入通常是 0.95，本地是估算，手动是 1.0。
samples.hypothesis: 质量分数记录每个TM条目的历史可靠性——AI写作0.95,本地估计自己,人工写作1.0.

samples.source: Fallback degradation must carry a reason so the caller can tell "could not translate" apart from "translated wrong but degraded anyway".
samples.reference: 兜底降级必须携带原因说明，让调用方知道 "翻不出" 和 "翻错了但降级返回" 是两回事。
samples.hypothesis: 退缩降解必须包含一个理由,以便呼叫者除了"翻译错误但无论如何退化"之外,还能分辨"无法翻译".

samples.source: No silent degradation is this product's hard constraint: every fallback must be written into the message field.
samples.reference: 不静默降级是本产品的硬约束：任何路径回落都要写进 message 字段。
samples.hypothesis: 没有任何无声的退化是这个产品的硬约束:每个倒计时都必须写入信息领域.

samples.source: Distillation extracts terms from AI quality translations and feeds them back into local engines, forming a "cheaper the more you use it" flywheel.
samples.reference: 蒸馏从 AI 精译结果中抽术语回灌本地引擎，形成 "越用越省" 的性价比飞轮。
samples.hypothesis: 蒸馏从AI质量翻译中提取术语并将其反馈到本地引擎中,形成一个"使用越便宜的"飞轮.

samples.source: Hit rate and quality score fight each other -- repeatedly hitting a low-quality memory pair poisons the output.
samples.reference: 命中率与质量分是彼此冲突的：低质量记忆对反复命中会污染输出。
samples.hypothesis: 命中率和质量得分相争——屡次击中一个低质量的记忆对子毒害了输出.

samples.source: The LRU cache should reserve a hit-rate threshold as the warm-up signal; the cold-start phase must not evict too aggressively.
samples.reference: LRU 缓存要预留一定命中率作为预热指标，冷启动阶段不能过早淘汰。
samples.hypothesis: LRU缓存应预留一个命中率阈值作为暖化信号;冷启动阶段不得过于猛烈驱逐.

samples.source: End-to-end evaluation samples must cover three scenarios: perfect hit, cache-quality-refused re-translation, and cold translation without cache.
samples.reference: 端到端评估的样本要覆盖三种场景：完全命中、缓存质量不足重译、无缓存纯翻译。
samples.hypothesis: 端对端评价样本必须涵盖三种情景:完美命中,缓存质量重译,冷译无缓存.

samples.source: Neural machine translation is extremely sensitive to the training domain -- a model trained on Wikipedia drops heavily when used on meeting transcripts.
samples.reference: 神经机器翻译对训练域极其敏感；把 Wiki 语料训出来的模型直接搬到会议记录，质量掉得很明显。
samples.hypothesis: 神经机翻译对训练领域极为敏感——在会议记录使用时,一个接受过维基百科培训的模型大量下降.

samples.source: A large language model can translate proper nouns in a cold start using world knowledge, but without term injection the same term can drift across a long document.
samples.reference: 大语言模型在冷启动阶段能靠世界知识翻译专有名词，但没有术语注入时同名词在长文档里译法会漂。
samples.hypothesis: 一个大型语言模型可以使用世界知识在寒冷的开端翻译适当的名词,但是没有术语注入,同一个术语可以漂移到一个长文档中.

samples.source: Statistical machine translation relies on phrase tables and aligned corpora; harder to maintain in production but latency is predictable.
samples.reference: 统计机器翻译依赖短语表与对齐语料，工程上比神经翻译更难维护但延迟可控。
samples.hypothesis: 统计机器翻译依赖于短语表和对齐的corpora;生产中更难维持,但耐久性是可预测的.

samples.source: The real-time factor RTF is the model's compute cost divided by the audio length; only RTF below 1 makes realtime feasible.
samples.reference: 实时因子 RTF 是模型耗时代价除以音频时长，小于 1 才可能做实时。
samples.hypothesis: 实时因子RTF是模型的计算成本除以音频长度;只有低于1的RTF才使得实时可行.

samples.source: Time-to-first-token decides the user's gut feeling of "fast"; total time decides whether they can "wait".
samples.reference: 首字延迟决定用户对 "快不快" 的第一印象；总时长决定 "等得起等不起"。
samples.hypothesis: 时间到第一键决定用户对"快速"的直觉;总时间决定他们是否可以"等待".

samples.source: Wall-clock time is measured end-to-end and includes queuing and network round-trips; it is not the same as CPU time.
samples.reference: 挂钟时间是端到端测出来的，包含排队与网络往返，与 CPU 时间不是一回事。
samples.hypothesis: 沃尔钟时间是测量端到端的,包括排队和网络圆路;这与CPU时间不同.

samples.source: The first inference during a cold start loads weights and builds the computation graph, taking an order of magnitude longer than steady state.
samples.reference: 冷启动阶段第一次推理会加载权重、构建计算图，比稳态慢一个数量级。
samples.hypothesis: 寒冷开始期间的第一个推论会加载重量并构建计算图,其数量顺序比稳定状态要长.

samples.source: Warmup usually fires a few synthetic requests to bring weights from disk into memory and to trigger lazy graph optimisation.
samples.reference: 预热一般用几条虚拟请求把权重从磁盘拉到内存并触发惰性优化。
samples.hypothesis: Warmup通常会点出几个合成请求,将磁盘上的重量带入内存,并触发懒惰的图优化.

samples.source: Memory footprint is a hard constraint for desktop products -- users will accept CPU slowness but not OOM.
samples.reference: 内存占用对桌面产品是硬约束，用户能接受 CPU 慢但不能接受 OOM。
samples.hypothesis: 内存足迹是桌面产品的一个硬约束 -- 用户会接受CPU缓慢但不接受OOM.

samples.source: Queries per second is a server metric and says little about a single-machine desktop product.
samples.reference: 每秒查询数是服务端指标，对单机桌面产品意义不大。
samples.hypothesis: 查询每秒是一个服务器的度量标准,对单机桌面产品说得很少.

samples.source: Profiling must separate inference time, codec time and I/O time, otherwise optimisation ends up targeting the wrong thing.
samples.reference: 性能剖析要区分推理耗时、编解码耗时与 IO 耗时，不然优化容易打偏。
samples.hypothesis: 剖析必须区分推论时间,编码时间和I/O时间,否则优化最终会针对错误的东西.

samples.source: End-to-end throughput is capped by the slowest stage; find the bottleneck before optimising.
samples.reference: 端到端吞吐受限于最慢的一段，优化前先找出瓶颈段。
samples.hypothesis: 端到端的吞吐量被最慢的阶段封顶;在优化前找到瓶颈.

samples.source: Benchmarks must pin the seed and the sampling policy, otherwise two runs on the same model are not comparable.
samples.reference: 基准测试要固定 seed、固定采样策略，两次跑同一模型输出应可复现。
samples.hypothesis: 基准必须确定种子和采样政策,否则两个样本在同一模型上是无法比较的。

samples.source: Latency measurements are ruined by concurrent downloads or antivirus scans; run them on an idle machine.
samples.reference: 延迟测试期间不能有并发下载或杀毒扫描，否则会污染数字。
samples.hypothesis: 延迟测量因同时下载或反病毒扫描而被破坏;用闲置的机器运行.

samples.source: In AV context a buffer is an audio buffer; in chemistry it is a buffer solution.
samples.reference: 缓冲区在 AV 域是 audio buffer；在化学语境下是 buffer solution。
samples.hypothesis: 在AV语境中,缓冲是音频缓冲;在化学中,缓冲是缓冲溶液.

samples.source: A stream in streaming synthesis is a data stream; in statistics it is a data stream too, but in geography it is a brook.
samples.reference: stream 在流式合成里是 "流"；在统计语境是 "数据流"，在地理语境是 "溪流"。
samples.hypothesis: 流体合成中的流体是数据流;在统计学中,流体也是数据流,但在地理学中,流体是溪.

samples.source: A channel in audio is a channel; in a message queue it is a channel; in marketing it is also a channel -- different meanings.
samples.reference: channel 在音频里是 "声道"；在消息队列里是 "通道"；在营销里是 "渠道"。
samples.hypothesis: 音频中的频道是一个频道;在信息队列中,它是一个频道;在营销中,它也是一个频道——不同的含义.

samples.source: A segment in VAD is a speech segment; in business it is a market segment; in geometry it is a line segment.
samples.reference: segment 在 VAD 里是 "语音段"；在商业语境是 "市场份额"；在几何是 "线段"。
samples.hypothesis: VAD中的一个部分是语音部分;在商业中它是一个市场部分;在几何学中它是一个线段.

samples.source: In TTS, voice most often means the speaker's timbre, not the physical sense of sound.
samples.reference: voice 在 TTS 里更常见的是 "音色 / 说话人声线"，不是物理意义的 "声音"。
samples.hypothesis: 在TTS中,语音最常是指扬声器的调子,而不是声音的物理感.

samples.source: Speech emphasises spoken language and the acoustic signal; voice leans toward the voice quality and the speaking subject.
samples.reference: speech 强调 "口语演讲" 与 "语音信号"；voice 更偏 "嗓音" 与 "说话主体"。
samples.hypothesis: 发言强调口语和声响信号;语音倾向于语音质量和语音主题。

samples.source: Frame means frame in the codec context and also frame in the picture/window context -- only surrounding text disambiguates.
samples.reference: frame 在编码域是 "帧"，在窗口/画框域也是 "frame"，靠上下文区分。
samples.hypothesis: Frame在代码上下文中指帧,在图片/窗口上下文中也指帧——只有周围的文本散开.

samples.source: Sample in audio is a discrete sample; in statistics it is a sampled unit -- the English word is the same.
samples.reference: sample 在音频域是 "样本 / 采样点"，在统计域是 "样本 / 抽样单位"。
samples.hypothesis: 音频中的样本是一个离散的样本;在统计学中,它是一个被样本的单位——英语单词是相同的.

samples.source: Model in machine learning is a trained predictor; in fashion or scale cars it is also a model.
samples.reference: model 在 ML 域是 "模型"，在时尚/模型汽车域也是 "model"。
samples.hypothesis: 机器学习中的模型是一个训练有素的预测器;在时尚或规模汽车中,它也是一个模型.

samples.source: Pitch in speech is fundamental frequency; in baseball it is a throw; in business it is a proposal.
samples.reference: pitch 在语音域是 "音高"，在棒球域是 "投球"，在商务域是 "提案"。
samples.hypothesis: 口头发言是基本的频率;在棒球中,是一种掷球;在商业中,是一种提议。

samples.source: Prosody appears only in phonetics -- a pure domain anchor.
samples.reference: prosody 只在语音学域用，其他语境几乎不出现，可作纯领域锚点。
samples.hypothesis: Prosody只出现在口音中——一个纯域主播.

samples.source: Vocoder is unique to speech engineering ("声码器"); most users will not recognise it, so the UI has to explain.
samples.reference: vocoder 是语音工程独有的 "声码器"，普通用户不认识，UI 中要加解释。
samples.hypothesis: Vocoder是语音工程("QQ")独有的;大多数用户不会认出它,所以UI必须解释.

samples.source: Diarization means speaker separation; combined with recognition it answers "who said what when".
samples.reference: diarization 是 "说话人分离"，与 recognition 组合成 "谁在什么时候说了什么"。
samples.hypothesis: 双音化意味着扬声器的分离;结合识别,它回答"谁说什么时候".

samples.source: Alignment in subtitle context is temporal alignment; in NLP it is cross-lingual alignment; in geometry it is arrangement.
samples.reference: alignment 在字幕域是 "对齐"，在 NLP 域是 "对齐（跨语言）"，在几何域是 "排列"。
samples.hypothesis: 字幕中的对齐是时间对齐;在NLP中是跨语言对齐;在几何上则是安排.

samples.source: Decoder is a hardware or software component in the codec sense, and also the second half of an NMT model -- related meaning, different implementation.
samples.reference: decoder 在编解码域是 "解码器"，在神经机器翻译域也是解码器，两侧含义相关但实现不同。
samples.hypothesis: 解码器是解码器意义上的硬件或软件组件,也是NMT模型的后半部分——相关意义,不同的执行.

samples.source: Encoder and decoder are symmetric; in neural networks both share the name, but in engineering one may be software and the other hardware.
samples.reference: encoder 与 decoder 对称；神经网络里两侧都用同名，工程里可能一个是软件一个是硬件。
samples.hypothesis: 编码器和解码器是对称的;在神经网络中,两者都共享名称,但在工程中,一个可能是软件,另一个是硬件.

samples.source: A codec is encoder plus decoder fused; the word is usually restricted to the compression domain.
samples.reference: codec 是 encoder + decoder 的合体，通常只在压缩域使用。
samples.hypothesis: 一个编码器是编码器加解码器的引信;这个词通常限于压缩域.

samples.source: In video engineering a container is a container format (mkv/mp4); in software deployment a container is a Docker container.
samples.reference: container 在视频工程是 "容器格式"（mkv/mp4），在软件部署是 "容器"（Docker）。
samples.hypothesis: 在视频工程中,容器是一种集装箱格式(mkv/mp4);在软件部署中,容器是一个Docker容器。

samples.source: In real-time audio and video, latency is the sum of network and decoding delays; in computer architecture it is pipeline latency.
samples.reference: latency 在实时音视频是网络与解码延迟总和；在计算体系结构里是流水线延迟。
samples.hypothesis: 在实时音频和视频中,延迟是网络和解码延迟的总称;在计算机架构中,是管道延迟.

samples.source: Jitter means network jitter in one context and clock jitter in another -- the mechanisms differ and translation must separate them.
samples.reference: jitter 在网络语境是 "抖动"，在时钟语境也是 "抖动"，两者机制不同要区分。
samples.hypothesis: Jitter指一种语境中的网络颤抖,另一种语境中的时钟颤抖 -- -- 各种机制不同,翻译必须将它们分开。

samples.source: Throughput and bandwidth are often conflated; the first is achieved work, the second is the theoretical ceiling.
samples.reference: throughput 与 bandwidth 常被混用；前者是实际吞吐，后者是理论上限。
samples.hypothesis: 吞吐量和带宽常被拼接;第一种是实现的工作,第二种是理论的上限.

samples.source: Chunk, packet and frame are three different granularities in streaming media and cannot all be translated as "块".
samples.reference: chunk 与 packet 与 frame 在流媒体里是三个不同粒度，翻译不能一律译成 "块"。
samples.hypothesis: Chunk,包和帧是流媒体中三个不同的颗粒,不能全部译为" ⁇ ".

samples.source: In the LLM domain a prompt is an instruction to the model; in the OS shell it is a command prompt -- entirely different meanings.
samples.reference: prompt 在 LLM 域是 "提示词"，在 OS 终端域是 "命令提示符"，两者完全不同。
samples.hypothesis: 在LLM域中,一个提示是给模型的指示;在OS shell中,它是一个命令提示——完全不同的意义.

samples.source: A token in NLP is a subword unit; in authentication it is an access token.
samples.reference: token 在 NLP 域是 "词元"，在身份认证域是 "令牌"。
samples.hypothesis: NLP中的一个符号是子词单位;在认证中它是一个访问符号.

samples.source: Transcode re-encodes; remux only rewraps. Their quality loss profiles differ fundamentally.
samples.reference: transcode 是重新编码；remux 是只重封装不重编码，两者的画质损失完全不同。
samples.hypothesis: Transcode re-encode; remux 只重新包装。 其质量损失剖面完全不同 。

samples.source: Burn-in hard-codes subtitles into the pixels; overlay draws them at render time. They sit at different stages of the pipeline.
samples.reference: burn-in 是硬字幕化，overlay 是叠加显示，两者在渲染管线上不同。
samples.hypothesis: 刻录硬码将字幕刻入像素; 覆盖在渲染时绘制。 它们坐落在管道的不同阶段 。

samples.source: When recording, check microphone gain before system volume -- clipping at the input cannot be undone by any algorithm.
samples.reference: 录音时先检查麦克风增益再检查系统音量，避免底噪被算法当语音。
samples.hypothesis: 在录制时, 在系统音量之前检查麦克风增量—— 任何算法都无法抵消输入的剪切 。

samples.source: Switching the output speaker on Windows rebuilds the audio graph, and many applications drop a frame during the change.
samples.reference: 扬声器切换在 Windows 上需要重启音频图，多数应用会掉一帧。
samples.hypothesis: 在Windows上切换输出扬声器可以重建音频图,许多应用程序在更改时会掉下一个帧.

samples.source: Dragging the playhead should explicitly seek to a keyframe; otherwise viewers see a block of corrupted frames during the transition.
samples.reference: 播放条拖动要显式触发关键帧 seek，不然会看到花屏过渡。
samples.hypothesis: 拖动播放头应该明确寻求一个键框;否则观看者会在过渡期间看到一个被腐蚀的框块.

samples.source: The preview pane renders soft subtitles by default; hard-burn is an explicit export option.
samples.reference: 预览窗口默认按软字幕渲染，导出时可以选择烧进画面。
samples.hypothesis: 预览面板默认会制作软字幕;硬燃烧是一个明确的导出选项.

samples.source: The timeline panel supports frame-level nudge -- left and right arrows step exactly one frame.
samples.reference: 时间轴面板支持逐帧微调，用左右方向键可以一帧一帧移动。
samples.hypothesis: 时间线面板支持帧级的冲动——左箭头和右箭头完全踩一个帧.

samples.source: Cut silence before exporting an edit, otherwise the final piece has meaningless gaps.
samples.reference: 剪辑导出前要先做静音剪裁，不然成片里会有无意义空白。
samples.hypothesis: 在导出编辑前剪切沉默, 否则最后的作品会有毫无意义的空白 。

samples.source: When importing AV footage, explicitly pick the frame-rate interpretation policy -- mixed-source clips drop frames otherwise.
samples.reference: 导入 AV 素材时最好显式选择帧率解释策略，跨制式素材容易掉帧。
samples.hypothesis: 在导入AV镜头时,要明确选择帧率解释政策——混合源剪辑另作选择的降帧.

samples.source: The waveform view lets the user hand-tune VAD boundaries, which is invaluable when the auto-segmentation mis-cuts.
samples.reference: 音频波形视图可以让用户手工微调 VAD 段边界，识别错切时特别有用。
samples.hypothesis: 波形视图让用户手调VAD边界,当自动分割错误剪切时,其价值可贵.

samples.source: When exporting bilingual subtitles, keep independent timestamps for each track -- sharing one drifts fast.
samples.reference: 导出双语字幕时两个轨要用独立时间戳，不要共用一个。
samples.hypothesis: 在输出双语字幕时,为每个音轨保留独立的时间戳——共享一个漂移速度.

samples.source: On machines with high preview latency, loosen the VAD threshold so users see the rough segmentation before refining.
samples.reference: 预览延迟过高的机器可以把 VAD 阈值调松，让用户先看到大致分段。
samples.hypothesis: 在具有高预览潜伏度的机器上,放松VAD阈值,这样用户在提炼前可以看到粗糙的分割.

samples.source: Detect sample rate and bit depth on import; if they mismatch, offer a resampling choice instead of silently converting.
samples.reference: 导入音频时检测采样率与位深，不匹配时给出重采样建议而不是静默转换。
samples.hypothesis: 检测样本率和导入时的比特深度; 如果它们不匹配, 则会提供一个重样选择, 而不是静态转换 。

samples.source: The local engine matrix covers three real engines -- argos, madlad and ollama -- plus a built-in demo as the last fallback.
samples.reference: 本地引擎矩阵覆盖 argos、madlad、ollama 三个真实引擎，加一个内置 demo 兜底。
samples.hypothesis: 本地引擎矩阵包括三个真正的引擎——agos, madlad和ollama——外加内置演示作为最后的倒计时.

samples.source: The sidecar binds only to 127.0.0.1 to enforce the privacy invariant: no external process can touch this machine's translation stream.
samples.reference: sidecar 只监听 127.0.0.1 保证隐私不变量：任何外部进程都不能访问这台机器上的翻译流。
samples.hypothesis: 侧车只绑定到127.0.0.1,以强制实施隐私的变异性:任何外部过程都不能触碰这台机器的翻译流.

samples.source: Language-pair tiering decides which engine runs; some cold pairs have no local engine at all.
samples.reference: 语言对是本地模型分档的核心维度，同一模型在不同语言对上质量差 15 分以上。
samples.hypothesis: 语言-pair分级决定了哪个引擎运行;一些冷配对完全没有本地引擎.

samples.source: When delivering the offline bundle, ship weights, vocabularies and configuration together -- the user's first launch should not need network access.
samples.reference: 交付离线整合包时要把模型权重、词表、配置文件一起打包，避免用户首启动还要联网下载。
samples.hypothesis: 在发送离线捆绑时,船的重量,词汇和配置在一起——用户的首次发射不需要网络访问.

samples.source: Quality mode and realtime mode differ not in speed but in budget: one permits AI upgrade, the other does not.
samples.reference: 精译档与实时档不是 "快慢" 之别，而是 "预算" 之别：一个允许升级 AI，一个不允许。
samples.hypothesis: 质量模式和实时模式在速度上并不不同,而是在预算上不同:一个允许AI升级,另一个不允许.

samples.source: The quality-preference toggle steers the upgrade policy of quality mode, choosing between "quality first" and "cost first".
samples.reference: 质量偏好开关影响精译档的升级策略，可以在 "质量优先" 与 "省成本优先" 之间二选一。
samples.hypothesis: 质量偏好切换引导质量模式的升级政策,在"质量第一"和"成本第一"之间作出选择.

samples.source: Fallback states explicitly that "the local model for this pair is missing", prompting the user to download rather than assume the product is broken.
samples.reference: 兜底降级会明确说明 "该语言对未装本地模型"，让用户去下载而不是误以为产品坏了。
samples.hypothesis: Fallback明确声明"此配对的本地模式缺失",促使用户下载而不是假设产品被打破.

samples.source: Every layer of the translation pipeline is observable: TM hit, privacy clamp, language-pair tiering, local engine, AI upgrade and confidence gating.
samples.reference: 翻译流水线的每一层判定都可观测：TM 命中、隐私钳制、语言对分档、本地引擎、AI 升级、置信度门控。
samples.hypothesis: 翻译管道的每个层都有可观察性:TM命中,隐私夹,语言-pair分级,本地引擎,AI升级和置信度ging.

samples.source: The model-licence matrix is part of the outward commitment -- Silero MIT, SenseVoice MIT, Kokoro Apache-2.0 and Argos MIT all clear.
samples.reference: 模型许可矩阵是产品对外承诺的一部分，Silero MIT、SenseVoice MIT、Kokoro Apache-2.0、Argos MIT 全绿。
samples.hypothesis: 模式许可矩阵是外向承诺的一部分——Silero MIT,SenseVoice MIT,Kokoro Apache-2.0和Argos MIT全部清楚.

samples.source: Execution providers are tiered by operating system: Windows prefers CUDA or DirectML, macOS prefers CoreML, Linux prefers CUDA.
samples.reference: 执行提供程序按操作系统分层：Windows 首选 CUDA 或 DirectML，macOS 首选 CoreML，Linux 首选 CUDA。
samples.hypothesis: 执行提供者通过操作系统分级:Windows更喜欢CUDA或DirectML,macOS更喜欢CoreML,Linux更喜欢CUDA.

samples.source: The training target of neural machine translation is to minimise cross-entropy, which only partially aligns with the human intuition of "faithfulness, expressiveness, elegance".
samples.reference: 神经机器翻译的训练目标是最小化交叉熵，与人类直觉的 "信达雅" 不完全重合。
samples.hypothesis: 神经机翻译的训练目标是最大限度地减少交叉内涵,这只与人类"信仰,表现,优雅"的直觉部分吻合.

samples.source: Translation memory and glossary solve different problems: the first reuses whole-sentence history, the second constrains word-level rendering.
samples.reference: 翻译记忆与术语表解决的是不同问题：前者复用整句历史，后者约束单词译法。
samples.hypothesis: 翻译内存和词汇解决了不同的问题:第一种是复用全刑史,第二种是限制词层渲染.

samples.source: Confidence should be bound to the translation itself, not to the engine -- the same model can drift across batches.
samples.reference: 置信度分数应该跟译文本身绑定，而不是跟引擎绑定；同一模型不同批次的输出置信度会漂移。
samples.hypothesis: 自信应该与翻译本身相连,而不是与引擎相连 -- -- 同一型号可以跨批漂移。

samples.source: A fallback path must preserve request context so the next layer can see why the previous one did not run.
samples.reference: 兜底降级路径要保留请求上下文，让下一层能知道上一层为什么没走通。
samples.hypothesis: 后退路径必须保存请求上下文, 这样下一层才能看到为什么前一层没有运行 。

samples.source: No-silent-degradation requires the response message to carry the full causal chain so the caller can decide to retry or prompt the user.
samples.reference: 不静默降级要求响应 message 字段携带完整原因链，调用方据此决定重试还是提示用户。
samples.hypothesis: 无声-降级需要响应消息携带完整的因果链,以便呼叫者可以决定重试或提示用户.

samples.source: The context window is a hard constraint on the LLM; long documents must be truncated or fed one sentence at a time, never stuffed whole.
samples.reference: 上下文窗口是 LLM 硬约束，长文档翻译要么截断要么按句喂，不能整段塞进去。
samples.hypothesis: 上下文窗口是 LLM 的硬约束;长文档必须一次切换或输入一个句子,从不填充整句.

samples.source: More few-shot examples are not always better -- five high-quality examples often beat twenty low-quality ones.
samples.reference: 少样本示例条数不是越多越好，5 条高质量示例往往优于 20 条低质量示例。
samples.hypothesis: 更少数的例子并不总是更好的 -- -- 五个高质量的例子往往比二十个低质量的例子要好。

samples.source: The distillation store threshold determines glossary signal-to-noise; too permissive lets wrong terms pollute every subsequent request.
samples.reference: 蒸馏的入库阈值决定了术语表的信噪比，太松会让错误术语污染后续所有请求。
samples.hypothesis: 蒸馏存储阈值决定了词汇信号到噪音;太任性让错误的术语污染了以后的每一个请求.

samples.source: Term injection into the prompt must specify format explicitly, otherwise the model reads the Chinese terms as explanatory prose.
samples.reference: 术语注入到提示词中要显式约束格式，不然模型会把中文术语当成解释性文本。
samples.hypothesis: 定期注入即时信息必须明确指定格式,否则模型将中文术语理解为解释性流言.

samples.source: A multilingual model's performance on cold pairs is bound by training corpus size, not model capacity.
samples.reference: 多语言模型对冷门语言对的表现受限于训练语料规模，不是模型容量。
samples.hypothesis: 一个多语种模型在冷配对上的性能受训练体积,而不是模型容量的约束.

samples.source: Neural machine translation's tokenizer is bound to its training corpus; using it on a different corpus makes the vocabulary hit rate collapse.
samples.reference: 神经机器翻译的分词器与训练语料绑定，跨语料使用时词表命中率会骤降。
samples.hypothesis: 神经机译器的代号器与它的训练体是紧密相连的;在不同的体格上使用它使得词汇的命中率崩溃.

samples.source: A large language model can do machine translation but is sensitive to prompt engineering -- the same source sentence can differ by a tier depending on the prompt.
samples.reference: 大语言模型可以做机器翻译，但对提示工程敏感，同一个源句换个提示可能质量差一档。
samples.hypothesis: 大型语言模型可以做机器翻译,但对即时工程很敏感——同一源句可以根据即时而因层次而异.

samples.source: Automatic evaluation cannot replace human evaluation; on narrow domains the correlation between chrF/BLEU/COMET and human judgement drops noticeably.
samples.reference: 自动评测不能替代人工评测；chrF/BLEU 与 COMET 与人工评分之间相关系数在窄域上会明显下降。
samples.hypothesis: 自动评价不能取代人类评价;在狭窄的领域,chrF/BLEU/COMET与人类判断之间的关系明显下降。

samples.source: Phrase tables in statistical machine translation degrade badly for pairs with large word-order gaps, e.g. Chinese to Finnish.
samples.reference: 统计机器翻译的短语表在语序差异大的语对之间退化严重，比如中文到芬兰语。
samples.hypothesis: 统计机器翻译中的词组表对有较大词序缺口的对子,如汉语到芬兰语,退化严重.

samples.source: Fuzzy match over translation memory sorts by edit distance or semantic distance; the returned top-k must stay small to avoid noise.
samples.reference: 翻译记忆的模糊匹配按编辑距离或语义距离排序，返回的 top-k 数量要克制。
samples.hypothesis: 通过编辑距离或语义距离在翻译记忆类型上模糊匹配;返回的顶-k必须保持小点以避免噪音.

samples.source: Confidence gating has to be stricter in realtime mode because realtime does not allow upgrade, and looser in quality mode because AI provides a floor.
samples.reference: 置信度门控在实时档要更严，因为实时档不接受升级；在精译档可以稍松，因为 AI 兜底。
samples.hypothesis: 由于实时不允许升级,因此在实时模式下信任型标注必须更加严格,而在质量模式下则由于AI提供地板而更加松散.

samples.source: Term injection behaves differently on local engines versus LLMs: local treats it as a hard constraint, LLMs integrate it into context before deciding.
samples.reference: 术语注入到本地引擎与注入到 LLM 的效果不一样：本地引擎把它当硬约束，LLM 会理解上下文再决定。
samples.hypothesis: 定期注入在本地引擎与LLMs上的表现不同:本地将它视为硬约束,LLMs在决定前将其融入上下文.

samples.source: Distillation output must distinguish "user confirmed" from "machine extracted"; the first can overwrite the second, not the other way round.
samples.reference: 蒸馏产出要区分 "用户已确认" 与 "机器自抽"，前者可以覆盖后者，反之不行。
samples.hypothesis: 蒸馏输出必须区分"用户确认"与"机器提取";第一种可以覆盖第二,而不是相反的回合.

samples.source: Hit rate and latency are usually positively correlated -- a higher hit rate means more repeated content and faster cached paths.
samples.reference: 命中率与延迟之间通常正相关；命中率越高说明重复内容越多，缓存路径也越快。
samples.hypothesis: 命中率和耐久性通常是正相关联的 -- -- 更高的命中率意味着内容重复更多,缓存路径更快.

samples.source: In end-to-end speech translation, ASR errors propagate into MT and then into TTS, so segment-level evaluation has to run independently.
samples.reference: 端到端语音翻译里 ASR 的错误会传染给 MT，再传染给 TTS，因此段级评估要独立跑。
samples.hypothesis: 在端到端的语音翻译中,ASR错误传播到MT,然后传播到TTS,因此片段级评价必须独立运行.

samples.source: Attention visualisation reveals which part of the source the model "looked at" but is not the same as interpretability.
samples.reference: 神经机器翻译的注意力可视化能揭示模型 "看到" 了源句的哪一部分，但不等于可解释性。
samples.hypothesis: 注意可视化揭示出该模型"看"的哪一部分来源,但与可解释性不同.

samples.source: Whether translation memory uses last-write-wins or best-quality-wins yields entirely different product semantics.
samples.reference: 翻译记忆的更新策略是 last-write-wins 还是 best-quality-wins，产品语义完全不同。
samples.hypothesis: 翻译内存是使用最后写成的赢还是最佳质量的赢产生完全不同的产品语义学.

samples.source: Prompt injection is one source of privacy risk for LLMs; glossary content must never include executable instructions.
samples.reference: 大语言模型的 prompt injection 是隐私风险的来源之一，术语表内容不能包含可执行指令。
samples.hypothesis: 快速注射是LLMs隐私风险的一个来源;词汇内容决不能包括可执行指令.

samples.source: A translation engine's fallback is not a simple "return original on failure" -- it must state why the translation did not happen.
samples.reference: 翻译引擎的兜底不是简单的 "翻不出来返回原文"，而是要明确 "为什么没翻出来"。
samples.hypothesis: 一个翻译引擎的倒置不是简单的"失败时返回原创"——它必须说明翻译为何没有发生.

samples.source: End-to-end evaluation samples must cover short, medium and long sentences -- short polysemy and long complex sentences fail in different ways.
samples.reference: 端到端评估的样本要覆盖短句、中句、长句三档，短多义词与长复杂句的失败模式不同。
samples.hypothesis: 端到端评价样本必须涵盖短句,中句和长句 -- -- 短的多语种和长的复杂句子以不同方式失效.

samples.source: User-locked entries have the highest priority: neither distillation nor seed-pack imports may overwrite them unless the user explicitly unlocks them.
samples.reference: 用户锁定条目优先级最高：蒸馏不能覆盖，导入种子包也不能覆盖，除非用户显式撤销。
samples.hypothesis: 用户锁定的条目享有最高优先权:蒸馏或种子包装进口都不能覆盖这些条目,除非用户明确解锁它们。

samples.source: Microphone gain that is too high produces clipped waveforms with no recognisable content and degrades ASR visibly.
samples.reference: 麦克风增益过高会让削波后的波形失去可识别性，ASR 会明显退化。
samples.hypothesis: 微型手机收益过高,产生没有可识别内容的剪切波形,明显降低ASR。

samples.source: Loudness normalisation for loudspeaker output must happen before encoding, not after decoding, or the dynamic range is lost.
samples.reference: 扬声器输出的音量归一化要放在编码前而不是解码后，否则动态范围会丢。
samples.hypothesis: 扩音器输出的大声常态化必须在编码前发生,而不是在解码后发生,否则就会失去动态范围.

samples.source: Silence trimming must follow VAD decisions rather than a naive energy threshold on the raw waveform.
samples.reference: 录音的静音剪裁要在 VAD 判定后做，不能在波形上做简单的能量阈值。
samples.hypothesis: 静默修剪必须遵循VAD的决定,而不是原始波形上的天真能量阈值.

samples.source: Cross-segment playhead jumps must trigger a flush, otherwise the previous segment's audio stays in the buffer.
samples.reference: 播放头跨段跳变时要触发一次 flush，不然缓冲里会残留上一段的音频。
samples.hypothesis: 跨区播放头跳必须触发冲浪,否则前段的音频会停留在缓冲器中.

samples.source: The timeline panel must distinguish video frame indices from audio sample indices; converting between them depends on frame rate and sample rate.
samples.reference: 时间轴面板要区分视频帧号与音频样本号；两者换算依赖帧率与采样率。
samples.hypothesis: 时间表面板必须区分视频帧指数和音频样本指数;二者之间的转换取决于帧率和样本率.

samples.source: Importing a subtitle file that contains a BOM must detect and strip it, or the first line carries an invisible character.
samples.reference: 导入含 BOM 的字幕文件要能识别并剥离 BOM，不然首行字幕会带上不可见字符。
samples.hypothesis: 导入包含BOM的字幕文件必须检测并剥离,或者第一行带有隐形字符.

samples.source: SRT export needs millisecond precision; ASS uses centiseconds -- the two formats are not interchangeable.
samples.reference: 导出为 SRT 时的时间戳精度到毫秒即可；ASS 需要到厘秒，两者格式不同。
samples.hypothesis: SRT导出需要毫秒精度;ASS使用百分秒-两种格式不能互换.

samples.source: The preview pane renders soft subtitles so users can toggle tracks; the export option must stay decoupled from this choice.
samples.reference: 预览窗口按软字幕渲染，让用户能开关字幕轨；导出选项要与之解耦。
samples.hypothesis: 预览面板让用户可以切换音轨, 这样用户可以切换音轨; 导出选项必须与这个选择保持脱钩 。

samples.source: When exporting an edit that only changes timing and not content, remuxing is enough -- do not introduce unnecessary re-encoding.
samples.reference: 剪辑导出时如果只改时间轴不改内容，重封装就够，不要引入不必要的二压。
samples.hypothesis: 当导出只更改时间而不是内容的编辑时,重置就足够了——不要引入不必要的重编码.

samples.source: Waveform and spectrogram views are complementary: the first shows energy distribution, the second shows frequency distribution.
samples.reference: 波形视图与频谱视图是互补的：前者看能量分布，后者看频率分布。
samples.hypothesis: 波形和光谱视图是互补的:第一种显示能量分布,第二种显示频率分布.

samples.source: Beam-forming on a microphone array markedly improves signal-to-noise for distant speakers, provided sample sync is preserved.
samples.reference: 麦克风阵列的波束成形能显著提升远处说话人的信噪比，前提是采样同步。
samples.hypothesis: 麦克风阵列上的光束阵形明显改进了远方扬声器的信号到噪声,前提是保持样本同步。

samples.source: Before export, verify sample rate, channels and bit depth in one pass and prompt on mismatch.
samples.reference: 导出前一次性校验源与目标的采样率、声道、位深三项，不匹配就提示。
samples.hypothesis: 在导出前, 一次验证样本速率、 通道和比特深度, 并提示不匹配 。

samples.source: Audio format conversion must let the caller choose whether to resample, and resampling must declare whether to use a high-quality filter.
samples.reference: 音频格式转换要显式选择是否重采样，重采样要声明是否走高质量滤波器。
samples.hypothesis: 音频格式转换必须让呼叫者选择是否重采样,重采样必须声明是否使用高质量的过滤器.

samples.source: Every outward-published number in this project must trace back to a measured run; estimates are labelled "estimated" without exception.
samples.reference: 项目里所有对外承诺的数字都要有实测来源；预估值一律标注 "估算"。
samples.hypothesis: 本项目中每个对外公布的数字必须追溯到一个量度运行;估计数无一例外地被标注为"估计".

samples.source: The sidecar binds only to the local loopback, and any external exposure would violate the privacy invariant explicitly.
samples.reference: 侧车进程只监听本机回环，任何对外暴露都是明确的隐私不变量违背。
samples.hypothesis: 侧车只与本地回路连接,任何外部接触都会明确侵犯隐私的变异性.

samples.source: Language-pair tiering decides which engine runs; cold pairs may not have any local engine at all.
samples.reference: 语言对分档决定了走哪个引擎；冷门语对可能压根就没有本地引擎可选。
samples.hypothesis: 语言-pair分级决定哪个引擎运行;冷配对可能根本没有任何本地引擎.

samples.source: When delivering an offline bundle the customer environment might be an air-gapped network, so neither models nor vocabularies may rely on runtime download.
samples.reference: 交付离线整合包时用户环境可能是离线内网，模型与词表都不能靠运行时下载。
samples.hypothesis: 在提供离线捆绑时,客户环境可能是一个空载网络,因此无论是模型还是词汇都不得依赖运行时间下载。

samples.source: Quality mode promises "escalate to AI when reachable", not "stay local forever".
samples.reference: 精译档的质量承诺包括 "AI 可达时尽量升级"，不是 "永远走本地"。
samples.hypothesis: 质量模式承诺"可达时向AI升级",而不是"永远停留在当地".

samples.source: The latency budget in realtime mode is a hard constraint; anything that would break it, AI upgrade included, must be explicitly disabled.
samples.reference: 实时档的延迟预算是硬约束，任何会打破预算的功能（比如 AI 升级）都要显式禁用。
samples.hypothesis: 实时模式的延迟预算是一个困难的制约因素;任何打破它,包括AI升级,都必须明确禁用.

samples.source: The quality-preference toggle is a two-way choice in settings; changes take effect only on restart so routing cannot mutate mid-flight.
samples.reference: 质量偏好在设置页二选一，保存后重启生效，避免运行中改路由造成状态混乱。
samples.hypothesis: 质量偏好切换是设置中的双向选择;更改只在重启时生效,所以路由不能突变中空.

samples.source: Fallback must distinguish "local model missing" from "external engine unreachable"; the first invites a download, the second a retry.
samples.reference: 兜底降级要区分 "本地模型缺失" 与 "外部引擎不可达"，前者可提示下载，后者要重试。
samples.hypothesis: Fallback必须区分"本地型号缺失"与"外部引擎无法到达";第一个邀请下载,第二个是重试.

samples.source: The model-licence matrix is part of the outward commitment; every new dependency goes through the licence gate.
samples.reference: 模型许可矩阵是产品对外承诺的一部分，任何新增依赖都要过许可门禁。
samples.hypothesis: 模式许可证矩阵是外向承诺的一部分;每一个新的依赖都通过许可证大门。

samples.source: Execution-provider selection must go through environment variables, never hard-coded in source.
samples.reference: 执行提供程序的切换要走环境变量，不要写死在源码里。
samples.hypothesis: 执行提供者的选择必须经过环境变量,绝不在源代码中硬化.

samples.source: Routing is observable: every translation exposes its route_plan over the diagnostics interface.
samples.reference: 路由决策是可观测的：每次翻译的 route_plan 都能通过诊断接口读回。
samples.hypothesis: 运行是可观察到的:每个翻译都暴露出其路径_计划,凌驾于诊断界面之上.

samples.source: Local engines and cloud engines are a hard boundary; privacy mode closes every path across that boundary.
samples.reference: 本地引擎与云端引擎之间是硬边界，隐私模式关闭这条边界上的所有通路。
samples.hypothesis: 本地引擎和云引擎是一个硬边界;隐私模式关闭了跨越该边界的每一个路径.

samples.source: The translation pipeline is data-driven: routes can be edited, and any unknown configuration key is echoed back rather than silently dropped.
samples.reference: 翻译流水线是数据驱动的：路由表可以改，未识别的配置键要显式回传不静默丢弃。
samples.hypothesis: 翻译管道是数据驱动的:路径可以编辑,任何未知的配置密钥都会回放而不是默投.

samples.source: Confidence estimation is not a raw model probability; it is a synthesis of quality heuristics, and the product says so.
samples.reference: 置信度估算不是模型输出概率，是模型质量启发式的合成，产品要如实说明。
samples.hypothesis: 信心估计不是一个原始模型概率;它是质量heuristics的合成,产品是这样说的.

samples.source: The end-to-end speech loop caps around 500 MB of model weight; anything larger is unfit for a first-launch download.
samples.reference: 端到端语音闭环的模型体积上限约 500 MB，超了就不适合首装下载。
samples.hypothesis: 端到端的语音循环封顶大约为500MB的模型重量;任何更大的都不适合第一次发射下载.

samples.source: Real-time interpretation products in the demo phase say "transcription plus translation"; promising "interpretation" is a narrative-discipline violation.
samples.reference: 实时同传产品在演示阶段常被称为 "转写 + 翻译"，不承诺 "同传" 是产品叙事纪律。
samples.hypothesis: 演示阶段的实时口译产品称"译注加翻译";有希望的"口译"是违反叙事纪律的行为.

samples.source: A batch localization pipeline should be able to import mp4, extract audio, run ASR, translate, and write soft subtitles back -- all four steps interruptible and resumable.
samples.reference: 批量本地化管线要能导入 mp4 抽音、走 ASR 转写、翻译、再回写软字幕，四步都能中断续跑。
samples.hypothesis: 一个批量本地化管道应该能够导入mp4,提取音频,运行ASR,翻译,并写回软字幕——所有四个步骤都是可中断的和可恢复的.

samples.source: Confidential-document scenarios require every local component to be obtainable offline; network features must be globally disableable.
samples.reference: 涉密文档场景要求所有本地组件都可离线获取，联网功能要能整体禁用。
samples.hypothesis: 机密文件设想方案要求每个本地组件都可以离线获取;网络特性必须可在全球禁用。

samples.source: The desktop client shows which engine actually ran each translation -- transparent traceability is a baseline promise of this product.
samples.reference: 桌面客户端要显示每次翻译实际走了哪个引擎，"透明可追溯" 是本产品的基本承诺。
samples.hypothesis: 桌面客户端显示哪个引擎实际运行每个翻译——透明的可追溯性是这个产品的基线承诺.

samples.source: Translation memory exports must be portable and shareable; but glossary seed packs must not carry user-private entries.
samples.reference: 翻译记忆导出要能带走或分享，但术语表按领域打包发布时不能携带用户私有条目。
samples.hypothesis: 翻译内存出口必须是便携式和可共享的;但词汇种子包不得携带用户-私人条目.

samples.source: End-to-end latency is the sum of VAD, ASR, MT and TTS; degradation in any one of them lands squarely on the user's face.
samples.reference: 端到端延迟由 VAD、ASR、MT、TTS 四段串联，任何一段劣化都会顶到用户脸上。
samples.hypothesis: 端到端耐性是VAD,ASR,MT和TTS的总称;在其中任何一种情况下,降解都会在使用者的脸上直线着陆.

samples.source: Batch job logs must persist per sentence, so a failed rerun can resume precisely at the erroring item rather than start over.
samples.reference: 批处理任务的日志要按句粒度落盘，失败重跑时能精确恢复到出错那一条而不是从头再来。
samples.hypothesis: 批量工作日志必须坚持每句,因此失败的重运行可以精确地在错误项恢复,而不是重新开始.

samples.source: Long-document translation is fed segment-by-segment or section-by-section, and cross-segment consistency is carried by translation memory plus glossary.
samples.reference: 长文档翻译要按段落或章节切分喂入，段间的一致性靠翻译记忆与术语表共同保证。
samples.hypothesis: 长文件翻译由逐段或逐节输入,交叉部分的一致性由翻译内存加词汇带去.

samples.source: Localising a multi-speaker podcast first routes each diarised speaker into their own synthesis channel, then rejoins them along the timeline.
samples.reference: 多说话人播客的本地化要先把不同说话人分流到各自的合成通道，再按时间线合流。
samples.hypothesis: 定位一个多语种播客,先是将每个配音演讲者带入自己的合成频道,然后沿着时间线重新加入.

samples.source: Confidential clients typically require on-premise delivery of batch localization, and any telemetry must be globally disableable.
samples.reference: 涉密客户的批量本地化通常要求现场部署，任何遥测都要能整体禁用。
samples.hypothesis: 保密客户通常需要预先交付批量本地化,任何遥测都必须是全球可禁用的。

samples.source: The glossary import endpoint enforces pack-level domain, source_lang and target_lang to prevent polluting the generic table.
samples.reference: 术语表的导入接口对包级 domain、source_lang、target_lang 三项做强制校验，防止污染通用表。
samples.hypothesis: 词汇表导入端点执行包级域名, source_lang和target_lang,以防止污染通用表.

samples.source: The request's domain field propagates into the TM hit check, so cross-domain memory is refused to avoid context mis-fit.
samples.reference: 翻译请求体的 domain 字段透传到 TM 命中的判断，跨 domain 的记忆不复用避免语境错配。
samples.hypothesis: 请求的域传播到TM命中检查中,因此交叉域内存被拒绝避免上下文错配.

samples.source: The distillation worker is asynchronous; when its queue is full it drops candidates rather than blocking the main path -- a deliberate latency-over-completeness choice.
samples.reference: 蒸馏 worker 是异步的，队列满时直接丢弃不阻塞主路径；这在延迟与完整性之间选了前者。
samples.hypothesis: 蒸馏工人是同步的;当排满排队时,它会丢掉候选人,而不是阻挡主路径 -- -- 一种刻意的耐久-超完成选择.

samples.source: The routing table is data-driven with four precedence levels in order: routes.json < settings.json < environment variables < initialisation JSON.
samples.reference: 路由表是数据驱动的：routes.json、settings.json、环境变量、初始化 JSON 四级优先级依次覆盖。
samples.hypothesis: 路由表由数据驱动,按顺序分为四个优先级: routes.json < settings.json < 环境变量 < 初始化 JSON.

samples.source: End-to-end evaluation samples carry sub-domain labels so per-group quality deltas ("pipeline core vs polysemy boundary") can be computed.
samples.reference: 端到端评测的样本要按子领域打标签，才能算出 "流水线核心 vs 多义词边界" 的分组质量差。
samples.hypothesis: 端到端评价样本带有子域标签,因此可以计算每个组的质量三角塔("管状核心对多塞米边界").

samples.source: The performance metric for batch localisation is sentences per hour; the realtime metric is end-to-end milliseconds -- two completely different scales.
samples.reference: 批量本地化的性能指标是 "每小时能翻多少段"，与实时场景的 "端到端多少毫秒" 是两套。
samples.hypothesis: 批量本地化的性能度量是时速的句子;实时度量是端到端的毫秒——两个完全不同的尺度.

samples.source: The first-launch experience of a desktop product matters: missing models must surface as a friendly UI message, not an exception.
samples.reference: 桌面产品的首次启动体验很重要：模型缺失时要在 UI 里明说而不是抛异常。
samples.hypothesis: 桌面产品首发体验事关:缺失的模型必须作为友好的UI消息浮出水面,而不是例外.

samples.source: Local model downloads must show progress and support resumable fetch; hundreds of megabytes to gigabytes are not worth restarting from zero.
samples.reference: 本地模型的下载要能显示进度并支持断点续传，几百 MB 到几 GB 的模型不适合一刀断重来。
samples.hypothesis: 本地模式下载必须显示进度, 并支持可重复获取; 数百兆字节到千兆字节不值得从零重新开始 。

samples.source: Switching between quality and realtime mode happens per request; a single batch can freely mix them without a global toggle.
samples.reference: 精译档与实时档的切换粒度是每请求；同一批里可以混着走，不用切档。
samples.hypothesis: 质量模式和实时模式之间的切换,每个请求都会发生;单批可以自由混合,而无需全局切换.

samples.source: The sidecar's lifecycle is managed by the UI layer -- health-poll on startup, graceful kill on shutdown.
samples.reference: sidecar 的生命周期由 UI 层管理，启动时轮询健康检查，退出时优雅 kill。
samples.hypothesis: 侧车的寿命周期由UI层管理——启动时健康污染,关闭时优雅的杀死.

samples.source: The contract between the Python sidecar and the Rust core is HTTP over JSON, with native bindings forbidden so no new dependency burden creeps in.
samples.reference: Python 侧车与 Rust 核心之间是 HTTP/JSON 契约，禁止 native binding 引入新的依赖负担。
samples.hypothesis: Python侧车与Rust核心之间的合同是HTTP凌驾于JSON之上,本地约束是被禁止的,因此不会出现新的依赖负担。

samples.source: Windows Smart App Control intercepts unsigned locally built DLLs, so product signing must cover every binary shipped.
samples.reference: Windows 智能应用控制会拦截未签名的本地构建 DLL，产品发布签名要覆盖所有二进制。
samples.hypothesis: Windows Smart App Control截取未签名的本地构建的DLL,因此产品签名必须覆盖每一个发送的二进制.

samples.source: The licence gate covers Cargo.lock, Python requirements, .NET csproj files, and any third-party material referenced from the docs.
samples.reference: 许可证门禁覆盖 Cargo.lock、Python requirements、.NET csproj 与文档引用的第三方素材。
samples.hypothesis: 许可证大门包括Cargo.lock、Python要求、.NET csproj文件以及文件中提到的任何第三方材料。

samples.source: Source-code comments are English throughout; user-facing documentation is Chinese with an English twin linked from the README.
samples.reference: 源码注释统一英文；文档面向中文用户，中英双版按 README 起头互链。
samples.hypothesis: 源码评论为英文通篇;用户-faceing文档为中文,与README连接的英文双音.

samples.source: Every externally published number must trace back to a reproducible evaluation run -- script, seed and timestamp included.
samples.reference: 所有对外发布的数字都要能追溯到一次可复现的评测运行，含脚本、种子、时间戳。
samples.hypothesis: 外部公布的每个数字必须追溯到可复制的评价运行 -- -- 包括脚本、种子和时间戳。

samples.source: Docs must not carry machine drive paths; every default path resolves through data_dir.
samples.reference: 文档中不出现机器盘符路径；所有默认路径都走 data_dir 解析。
samples.hypothesis: Docs不能携带机器驱动路径;每个默认路径都会通过数据_dir解决.

samples.source: Build entry points are Python scripts, with a thin .bat on Windows and .sh on Linux as OS-level wrappers.
samples.reference: 构建入口以 Python 脚本为主，Windows 与 Linux 各配一个 .bat / .sh 做 OS 级薄壳。
samples.hypothesis: 构建切入点是Python脚本,Windows上有一个薄的.bat,Linux上有一个.sh作为OS级包装.

samples.source: The pre-commit hook dispatches different checks by file path and only allows a commit when every applicable check passes.
samples.reference: pre-commit 钩子按路径触发不同检查，全绿才允许 commit。
samples.hypothesis: 预先承诺的钩子会按文件路径发出不同的检查,并且只有在每一个适用的检查通过时才允许承诺.

samples.source: Conventional Commits is the message convention: type(scope): subject says "what changed in which part" in a single line.
samples.reference: Conventional Commits 是提交信息规范，type(scope): subject 一行说清 "改了什么的哪部分"。
samples.hypothesis: 常规承诺是信息公约:类型(范围):主题在单行中表示"在哪个部分中发生了什么变化".

samples.source: Pathspec-scoped commits are the atomicity guarantee in concurrent collaboration; a shared staging area is easily swept by another session's commit.
samples.reference: pathspec 限定提交是并发协作下的原子性保障；共享暂存区容易被别的会话扫走。
samples.hypothesis: 路径范围承诺是同时合作的原子学保证;一个共享的中转区很容易被另一场会的承诺所覆盖。

samples.source: Patch files must state their line-ending policy explicitly; under autocrlf=true on Windows a checkout may otherwise break git apply.
samples.reference: patch 文件要显式说明行尾策略，Windows 下 autocrlf=true 检出可能破坏 git apply。
samples.hypothesis: 补丁文件必须明确声明其行中政策;在 autolcrf= true 在 Windows 下, 退出可能会打破 git 应用 。

samples.source: "缓存" is cache in a CDN context but buffer in a video buffering context; conflating them misleads the reader.
samples.reference: "缓存" 在 CDN 语境是 cache，在视频缓冲语境通常是 buffer；两者混用会误导读者。
samples.hypothesis: "QQ"在CDN语境中是缓存,但在视频缓冲语境中是缓存;将其缩合会误导读者.

samples.source: "编码器" and "加密器" are near-homographs in Chinese but encoder and encryptor in English -- the translation must not slide.
samples.reference: "编码器" 与 "加密器" 中文近似但英文完全不同：encoder 与 encryptor，翻译不能滑。
samples.hypothesis: "QQ"和"QQ"是中文的近似同名词,但英语的编码器和加密器——翻译不能滑动.

samples.source: "解码器" and "解密器" are equally confusable: decoder versus decryptor -- decide by compression domain or security domain.
samples.reference: "解码器" 与 "解密器" 同样易混：decoder 与 decryptor，看是压缩域还是安全域。
samples.hypothesis: "QQ"和"QQ"是同等的可混淆性: 解码器对解码器——由压缩域或安全域决定.

samples.source: A video keyframe and an animation keyframe share the Chinese term "关键帧" but denote different things.
samples.reference: "关键帧" 是 video keyframe；"关键帧动画" 是 animation keyframe；同名不同物。
samples.hypothesis: 一个视频键框和一个动画键框共同使用中文术语"QQ",但表示不同的东西.

samples.source: "声道" and "通道" both render as channel in English; the UI must pick one explicitly by domain rather than default.
samples.reference: "声道" 与 "通道" 在英文都是 channel；中文 UI 要根据域强制选一个不能默认。
samples.hypothesis: " ⁇ "和" ⁇ "都作为英语的频道渲染;UI必须明确通过域名而不是默认来选择一个.

samples.source: "分词" is tokenization in NLP but may be word segmentation in Chinese text processing -- the two operate at different granularity.
samples.reference: "分词" 在 NLP 是 tokenization，在中文文本处理还可能是 word segmentation，两者粒度不同。
samples.hypothesis: "QQ"在NLP中是象征性的,但在中文文本处理中可能是单词分割——两者在不同的颗粒态中运行.

samples.source: "重采样" in audio is resampling; in statistics it is bootstrap sampling -- the surrounding domain decides the rendering.
samples.reference: "重采样" 在音频域是 resample，在统计域是 bootstrap 采样；上下文域决定译法。
samples.hypothesis: 音频中的"QQ"是重新标注;在统计学中它是靴子带采样——周围域决定渲染.

samples.source: "预训练" and "预热" both start with "pre-" in Chinese, but they are pretraining and warmup in English -- completely different engineering meanings.
samples.reference: "预训练" 与 "预热" 在中文里都含 "pre"，英文是 pretraining 与 warmup，工程语义完全不同。
samples.hypothesis: "QQ"和"QQ"都以中文的"pre-"开头,但都是英语的预训和热身——完全不同的工程意义.

samples.source: When the decode thread stalls on the queue, flushing the buffer once usually gets the pipeline moving again.
samples.reference: 解码线程卡在队列上时，冲刷一次缓冲区通常就能让流水线重新动起来。
samples.hypothesis: 当排队时解码线条摊位,冲出缓冲器一次通常会让管道再次移动.

samples.source: The backpressure signal has to reach the capture side, otherwise the buffer overflows without anyone noticing.
samples.reference: 背压信号要一路传到采集端，否则缓冲区会在无人察觉时溢出。
samples.hypothesis: 后压信号必须到达捕捉方,否则缓冲器会在无人注意的情况下溢出.

samples.source: Raising the chunk size from 20 ms to 40 ms increases end-to-end latency but tolerates network jitter better.
samples.reference: 把分块大小从 20 毫秒调到 40 毫秒，端到端延迟会上升但网络抖动的容忍度变好。
samples.hypothesis: 将块大小从20ms提高到40ms会提高端到端的耐久性,但能更好地容忍网络的焦躁。

samples.source: When the data stream is duplicated in the middle layer, the frame numbering of both copies must not advance independently.
samples.reference: 数据流在中间层被复制两份时，要注意两份的帧序号不能各自递增。
samples.hypothesis: 当数据流在中层复制时,两个拷贝的帧编号都不得独立推进.

samples.source: Whenever a thread pool is introduced anywhere in the pipeline, the ordering guarantee of speech-segment end events must be rechecked.
samples.reference: 流水线里任何一段引入线程池，都要重新检查语段结束事件的顺序保证。
samples.hypothesis: 每当管道的任何地方引入一个线池时,必须重新检查对语音分区终端事件的定购保证.

samples.source: Queue depth is an observable and should appear in the diagnostics endpoint next to time to first packet.
samples.reference: 队列长度是观测项，应该和首包延迟一起出现在诊断接口里。
samples.hypothesis: 队列深度是可观察的,应该出现在第一包旁边的诊断端点上。

samples.source: After streaming recognition is cut off mid-way, the resume position must be recorded in frames rather than in seconds.
samples.reference: 流式识别在中途断线后，续传位置要以帧为单位记录而不是以秒为单位。
samples.hypothesis: 在流体识别被中途切断后,恢复位置必须用帧而不是秒来记录.

samples.source: When audio is processed in chunks, block boundaries must align to samples, or clicks appear at the seams.
samples.reference: 分块处理音频时，块边界要对齐到采样点，否则会在交界处产生咔哒声。
samples.hypothesis: 在用块处理音频时,块边界必须和样品对齐,或者点击接合处出现.

samples.source: The buffering policy must state whether it drops the oldest frame or blocks the producer; the two semantics differ completely.
samples.reference: 缓冲策略要显式声明是丢弃最旧还是阻塞生产者，两者语义完全不同。
samples.hypothesis: 缓冲策略必须说明是放下最古老的帧还是阻挡制片人;两种语义完全不同.

samples.source: The pipeline has to flush every stage before shutdown, otherwise the final speech segment disappears without a trace.
samples.reference: 流水线在关闭前要先冲刷所有阶段，否则最后一个语段会静默消失。
samples.hypothesis: 管道在关闭前必须冲刷每个阶段,否则最后的语音部分会消失无踪.

samples.source: The runtime puts the decoder on a worker thread, leaving the UI thread to only refresh the timeline.
samples.reference: 运行时把解码器放在工作线程上，界面线程只负责时间轴刷新。
samples.hypothesis: 运行时间将解码器放在工人线上,让UI线程只刷新时间线.

samples.source: Rebuilding the feature-dimension array every frame causes noticeable garbage-collection pressure; reuse the buffer instead.
samples.reference: 每帧都重建特征维度的数组会造成明显垃圾回收压力，应当复用缓冲。
samples.hypothesis: 重建每个框架的特性分割阵列都会产生明显的垃圾收集压力;而是重新使用缓冲器。

samples.source: An inference service should report its concurrency limit together with queue depth so operators can judge how long the line is.
samples.reference: 推理服务的并发上限应当与队列长度一起上报，便于运维判断排队规模。
samples.hypothesis: 一个推断服务应该报告它的货币极限和队列深度,这样操作员就可以判断该线的长度.

samples.source: The reconnect policy for streaming transport must separate a server-initiated close from network jitter.
